videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When actor Ritika gets a renewed threat from her stalker, Milan, she reaches out to EYES, a team specifically devoted to protecting victims of stalkers. She is disappointed to know that the team that had made her feel protected was no longer operational.

videos.title: Episode 2

videos.overview: Having restarted their work in protecting victims and helping stalkers overcome their issues, the EYES team has to go back to their old cases and make up for any lapses in their understanding – for instance, Sajin Zachariah’s side of the story his wife has said about him.

videos.title: Episode 4

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Unexpected setbacks from within and outside the team lead EYES to once again question what they are doing and why. But they know there is only one way to go – forward.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A team member’s actions puts the fate of EYES in jeopardy. Another’s doubt proves vital in setting a wrong right. Slowly but surely, the team moves closer to its goals.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When the protectors turn the hunted and long-hidden truths emerge, Team EYES proves beyond doubt that the mission is safe in their hands.

videos.title: The Dreamer
videos.overview: Bitten by the movie bug, Firoz dreams of becoming a film actor. Till then he makes do with album-song shoots. During a 90th birthday celebration, he gets an opportunity.

videos.title: The Hero, The Villain
videos.overview: Firoz arrives at the film shoot with his friends and asks the director for a chance. Will Firoz's dreams finally come true?

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum that he better marry his friend's daughter and live according to him. But Firoz has another trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: First Sight
videos.overview: Firoz is shocked by the surprise Mammali had in store for him at the house. His mother, worried about him, recruits his friends to help him find a girl to fall in love with.

videos.title: The Wrong Salma

videos.overview: Firoz and his friends bribe Ali to make him work for them in their plan to woo Salma. Will Ali genuinely help Firoz, or will he take him on a merry ride?

videos.title: The Bus Ride
videos.overview: Firoz desperately follows Salma onto a bus but, instead of getting in, ends up clinging to it outside. Just then, Mammali and Sainaba spot him.

videos.title: Too Late
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends visit Salma’s house with a marriage proposal. However, Firoz is heartbroken when he learns that Salma’s wedding has already been fixed with Thaju.

videos.title: Operation Thajudeen
videos.overview: Firoz's mother investigates whether Thaju, the man whose marriage to Salma has been arranged, has another love interest. How will Firoz's friends help him?

videos.overview: Ali tells Mammali that it was Firoz who brought Sneha to make Thaju fall in love with her. Sneha and Thaju become acquainted and their relationship begins to grow.

videos.overview: Mammali hides Sneha after she arrives at his house. Seeing this, his wife Sainaba becomes suspicious that something is going on.

videos.title: The Birthday Trap
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends learn from Salma's friends that it is her birthday. They plan to trick Mammali and buy a ring for Salma.

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends finally realise which Salma's family they've been chasing so far. Infuriated, they call Ali and find out something that increases their anger.

videos.title: Five Lakhs

videos.title: Love or Cinema?
videos.overview: At the coffee shop, Salma finally openly confesses her love to Firoz. However, Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum.

videos.title: The Double Dream
videos.overview: After Salma says yes to Firoz, he worries that choosing her means giving up his dream. Seeing Firoz caught between love and cinema, Charlie and Midukkan come up with a plan.

videos.overview: Following Firoz's plan, Aliya agrees to get engaged within a month and marry after a year. When he decides to tell Salma everything, his friends warn him.

videos.overview: While Firoz produces an album for Salma, he and Aliya go through with their fake engagement. Everything goes according to plan until an uninvited guest crashes the ceremony.

videos.overview: Family visits, intense challenges and emotional outbursts - Mohanlal discusses the eventful week. He delights them with a game of dumb charades, while someone packs to leave.

videos.title: Episode 75 - Day 74 - BBS6 News Live
videos.overview: Norah's morning activity ends in arguments. The housemates buckle up for the bricks and papers tasks and later enjoy a good laugh with Apsara, Sijo, and Sai's live reporting.

videos.title: Episode 76 - Day 75 - Bonus Bonanza
videos.overview: The season's final jail nomination puts Norah and Abhishek on the line. In the ninth TTF Task, teams fiercely compete and engage in heated debates for crucial bonus points.

videos.title: Episode 77 - Day 76 - Season's Final Captain
videos.overview: Mohanlal rewards TTF task winners and asks the housemates to select a potential finalist. A new captain emerges as the season's last, while one of them braces for eviction.

videos.title: Episode 78 - Day 77 - Curtain Raiser
videos.overview: Mohanlal questions Jinto's advice to Jasmine and sparks a discussion on hard work and luck. Later, he kicks off the TTF curtain raiser task while Rishi and Ansiba await eviction.

videos.title: Episode 79 - Day 78 - One Last Chance to Nominate
videos.overview: BB prompts individual play, leading to this season’s emotional final nomination. Subsequently, laughter and excitement fill the atmosphere as Team Pani visits the housemates.

videos.title: Episode 80 - Day 79 - Ticket to Finale Week
videos.overview: Eyeing the ticket to the finale, housemates pull up their socks to outdo each other in three challenges. Amidst it all, Sijo, Sai and Nandana engage in playful bickering.

videos.title: Episode 81 - Day 80 - TTF with CID Ramdas
videos.overview: The day dawns with a lively task where contestants speculate who fits each scenario. CID Ramdas adds his comical twists to TTF Task 6 and ignites the competitive energy.

videos.title: Episode 82 - Day 81 - Questions, Quarrels and Confrontations
videos.overview: Yet another balancing challenge takes it out of the housemates, while the consecutive task causes chaos in the house. Will the final scoreboard turn upside down?

videos.title: Episode 83 - Day 82 - Meet the First Finalist
videos.overview: The final showdown for the ticket sees Arjun anxious over his clash with Nandana in task 9. BB shakes up the house by cancelling further challenges and reveals the first finalist.

videos.title: Episode 84 - Day 83 - TTF Recap
videos.overview: Lalettan discusses and reviews housemates' game play in the TTF series. Jasmine and Sijo receive a task for tomorrow, as nominees brace themselves for the impending eviction.

videos.title: Episode 85 - Day 84 - A Twist in Eviction
videos.overview: An electrifying news report and exciting games unfold after the housemates meet Mohanlal. Later, as Abhishek claims the ticket, the evictee faces an unexpected twist.

videos.title: Episode 86 - Day 85 - Mirror, Mirror on the Wall
videos.overview: Norah executes her hilariously spooky act before the nominations, while Abhishek and Rishi shine in Kalikkalam task. BB introduces an opportunity for all to self-reflect.

videos.title: Episode 87 - Day 86 - BB's Enticing Offer
videos.overview: Housemates crown Sai as the king in an interesting Naaturajavu task. Later, BB's money box debuts with a tantalising 'take it or leave it' offer. Will anyone seize the chance?

videos.title: Episode 88 - Day 87 - A Crisis for Queen Jasmine
videos.overview: King Jinto crowns Jasmine as the successor after she wins his contests. However, she breaks down when her kingdom collapses. What sparked this dramatic turn of events?

videos.title: Episode 89 - Day 88 - Rib-Tickling Role Reversals
videos.overview: Housemates hilariously cosplay as each other for a task, with the impersonator 'Norah' stealing the show. Later, their excitement peaks as actress Urvashi makes a surprise visit.

videos.title: Episode 90 - Day 89 - BB Film Audition
videos.overview: As a part of Mohanlal's surprises, BB pairs the housemates for a film audition. Anticipation mounts when Jeethu Joseph and Antony Perumbavoor join them with a grand announcement.

videos.title: Episode 1 - Season Premiere
videos.overview: It's showtime! Lalettan unveils a brand new season filled with glamour, excitement, and unforgettable performances. What surprises await our contestants?

videos.title: BBMal: Season Premiere
videos.overview: The stage is set! Lalettan returns with a brand new season filled with glamour, excitement, and spectacular performances. What surprises lie ahead?

videos.title: BBMal Day 1: Clashes, Votes, Power Moves
videos.overview: First day in the house, the contestants are already locking horns. But leaders emerge, and the housemates need to convince each other why they shouldn't be evicted.

videos.title: BBMal Day 2: A Leader’s Toughest Choice
videos.overview: Jaseela, the leader, has a difficult choice to make today: eat only congee for 100 days or evict one housemate. What will she choose?

videos.title: BBMal Day 3: Bigg Boss Cuts Off the Basics
videos.overview: The water and gas supply is cut off as the ‘Palathulli Peruvellam’ task begins, sparking a kitchen clash. Meanwhile, the leader faces a crucial choice over the house’s food budget.

videos.title: BBMal Day 4: Cooking Chaos Without Gas
videos.overview: The Cooking Gas Task reaches a conclusion when Sreelakshmi and Rini clash over food serving. Everyone battles for the Jail Free Pass, but the real fight happens after the task.

videos.title: BBMal Day 5: Jail Drama and a Luxury Budget Twist
videos.overview: Jail nomination turns heated as Eldho calls the ruling party a failure. Rini gets emotional with Rahul over her past case, and the housemates earn luxury budget access.

videos.title: BBMal Day 6: Lalettan Exposes Hypocrisy
videos.overview: Mohanlal questions the housemates' every action: be it Rahul's gameplay or Shijin with the luxury budget. But he has the toughest one for Jaseela regarding Gayathri's eviction.

videos.title: BBMal Day 7: The House Gets a Double Surprise
videos.overview: Mohanlal questions housemates' involvement and reviews their democracy paintings before a mask task exposes who they find fake. The night ends with one exit and two big surprises.

videos.title: BBMal Day 8: Re-Election and Red Paint Revenge
videos.overview: Housemates call for a re-election after a trust vote fails, picking two contenders for the crown. Red paint fuels nomination drama as clashes break out over strategies and duties.

videos.title: BBMal Day 9: The Battle Begins in BB City 2.0
videos.overview: Gayathri makes a comeback. The Mission Road Task turns intense as teams compete to grab properties from each other. However, greed escalates the fights.

videos.title: BBMal Day 10: Can New Contractors Save BB City?
videos.overview: Rakesh and Noby take over as the new contractors of BB City. Physical task fights brew between Jaseela and Shibna, hygiene sparks rows, and Kadal Komban’s cash grab flops hard.

videos.title: BBMal Day 11: Broken Rules and Cash Heists
videos.overview: Bigg Boss calls off the task over rule breaks. Noby faces backlash over cheating, Komban’s cash heist angers Azif, and surprise nominations spark a heated Shijin-Mridula dispute.

videos.title: BBMal Day 12: Jail Food Before Actual Jail Time
videos.overview: The housemates quarrel over always being served porridge for meals. Soon after, the captaincy race takes an unexpected twist, and a gruelling jail task decides who gets locked in.

videos.title: BBMal Day 13: Lalettan Confronts Rahul and Azif
videos.overview: Mohanlal opens a debate on democracy, exposes Rahul’s domineering leadership, crowns Noby Player of the Week, and sternly warns Azif over his foul language.

videos.title: BBMal Day 14: Secrets Out and an Eviction In
videos.overview: Mohanlal addresses nomination, a secret milk drinking video stuns the house, and a hygiene debate leads to an eviction. Plus, a special surprise awaits Mohanlal from Bigg Boss.

videos.title: BBMal Day 15: Nomination Task and Explosive Fights
videos.overview: Aishwarya slams Komban after fighting with Neha. Meanwhile, everyone questions the leader’s nomination picks and the Commoner task leads to heated fights.

videos.title: BBMal Day 16: Mass Break-In and Massive Food Raid
videos.overview: House access gets restricted, but Eldho steals the timer, prompting the leader to block entry. But locked-out housemates break in, causing property damage.

videos.title: BBMal Day 17: Bans, Brawls and Blockades
videos.overview: Sreelakshmi steals eggs, which sparks a food ban. While the leader picks two housemates to enter the house, the Movie Poster Task is cancelled after fights get too physical.

videos.title: BBMal Day 18: Lines Crossed, No Task, Only Trouble
videos.overview: Aggression between Tashi and Gautham causes alarm. Bigg Boss summons them separately, cancels the weekly task, and promises strict action over the weekend.

videos.title: BBMal Day 19: Order, Order! Jail Becomes Court
videos.overview: Jail nomination sees Shibina, Tashi and Shijin with the highest votes. The nominees face a court task where they must choose an advocate to fight their case.

videos.title: BBMal Day 20: Lalettan Issues an Ultimatum
videos.overview: The house and Noby come under fire when Mohanlal brings up the week's unruly behaviour. The tension escalates when the star directly nominates housemates for next week.

videos.title: BBMal Day 21: Lalettan Demands Answers
videos.overview: Mohanlal tackles courtroom drama, clears house conflicts, and awards Sreelakshmi a golden apron with special perks. Sumesh's team performs a play before one contestant packs bags.

videos.title: BBMal Day 22: Inventory Task Goes Topsy-Turvy
videos.overview: Rahul and Shijin go head-to-head in the leadership candidate selection. When the final 4 are selected, a task with house inventory gives everyone a chance. However, chaos erupts.

videos.title: BBMal Day 23: Vampires, Villagers and Revolt
videos.overview: A ballot vote elects the new leader, but Tashi refuses to take part. The house embraces horror as the Vampires vs Villagers task begins.

videos.title: BBMal Day 24: Secret Tasks and Prank Drama
videos.overview: The secret tasks push the house to chaos. Loletta and Azif swap sides, and the Villagers pull off a staged fight to win a secret mission.

videos.title: BBMal Day 25: Twisted Mind Games and Team Swaps
videos.overview: Azif and Jaseela clash over stolen rice. Mind games fail as no one switches sides, but a task win lets Vampires pick a Villager before the intense cultural round final showdown.

videos.title: BBMal Day 26: Leadership Reality Check for Shijin
videos.overview: The housemates share the pros and cons of Shijin's leadership during the morning activity. At the jail nomination, Shijin unleashes his special leader power. Who is it for?

videos.title: BBMal Day 27: Mass Eviction Hits the House
videos.overview: A mass eviction announcement shocks clueless housemates. A Freeze Release task begins with a fight before multiple evictions roll out, leading to a Secret Room twist.

videos.title: BBMal Day 28: Four New Wildcards Shake the House
videos.overview: The spit controversy explodes after Shijin questions Aishwarya over spitting on Komban. Later, four surprise wildcard entrants step inside to shake up the entire house.

videos.title: BBMal Day 29: Wildcards Seize Captaincy
videos.overview: Big Boss appoints the four wildcards as house captains to lead duties. With direct nomination power in their hands, the new leaders turn the eviction process upside down.

videos.title: BBMal Day 30: Secret Tasks, Tears and Exit Plea
videos.overview: Shijin argues over missing food, while Nilina and Noby get upset over a comment. Wildcards get a secret task, and Suvarna breaks down in the confession room, asking to quit.

videos.title: BBMal Day 31: Candy Clash Saga
videos.overview: The Mittayi Pattanam task takes over the house, and everyone gets consumed by candies. Meanwhile, Suvarna finally makes a tough decision.

videos.title: BBMal Day 32: Bigg Trouble in Candy House
videos.overview: The housemates land in hot water due to complaints, cheating, rule-breaking and causing disorder. In between fights and rising tension, Bigg Boss welcomes two guests.

videos.title: BBMal Day 33: Leadership Ratings and Janasabha
videos.overview: The housemates rate wildcards for their leadership, which turns ugly. Later, Aishwarya breaks down in the confession room as this week's Janasabha begins.

videos.title: BBMal Day 34: Lalettan's Revelations and Warnings
videos.overview: Mohanlal tackles groupism, exposes Rahul as a puppeteer, and takes away Noby's trophy. Later, video evidence puts Noby on notice, while Tashi lands in deep trouble for aggression.

malayalam-series.name: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
malayalam-series.description:
Bigg Boss Agnipariksha is a Malayalam reality television spin-off that airs on JioHotstar as a prequel to Bigg Boss Malayalam. The series follows a group of 40 ordinary contestants who face physical, mental and social challenges to earn a coveted spot inside the Bigg Boss Malayalam house. Throughout the competition, the contestants are tested on their resilience, teamwork, leadership, adaptability and decision-making under pressure. Each challenge forces them to prove their personality, determination and ability to handle the intense environment associated with the Bigg Boss format. As the competition progresses, only the strongest and most deserving participants will get the chance to become official contestants in the upcoming season of Bigg Boss Malayalam.


📅 OTT Release: 2026-09-05
⭐ Rating: 6.0/10

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: A Face-Off Over the Selection

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Tears, Truths, and High Thrills
videos.overview: A perfect mix of high stakes action and pure excitement today. Personal stories bring contestants to tears before the explosive glasses task kicks off.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Two Special Guests Onstage
videos.overview: Fan favorites Rajith Kumar and Veena Nair judge an explosive showdown! Tension rises and energy peaks as contestants push their limits to survive the ultimate Agnipareeksha.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Nadira and Cereena Join the Drama

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Eviction Nominations

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: A Day of Surprises
videos.overview: An intense rope game pushes contestants into a chaotic battle. Unexpected twists raise the stakes, while the judges unveil a game-changing reward.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Onam Celebrations and Fun Games
videos.overview: The contestants celebrate Onam with grand laughter, and high-spirited games. As everyone come together for the festive cheer, they create some unforgettable moments.

videos.overview: The contestants are pushed to their limits when competition takes precedence over friendship. Unexpected reactions and explosive moments builds on the drama

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Circle of Trust
videos.overview: Guest judges Kutty Akhil and Suchithra bring high-energy entertainment. However the contestants face a check on their strategies, loyalties and game spirit.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Guests Arrive with Mystery Boxes
videos.overview: Kidilam Firoz and Poli Firoz enter with mysterious surprise boxes and exciting twists unfold. Intense drama and hilarious moments bring thrilling suspense in the house.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Wild Talent Meet Extreme Tasks

videos.overview: A suspenseful nomination task uncovers hidden faces and motives. As the contestants go through a brutal roasting session, they turn on their self-defense mode.

malayalam-series.name: Cousins and Kalyanams
malayalam-series.description:
A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar
📅 OTT Release: 2026-08-28
⭐ Rating: 5.8/10

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: On the eve of Manu's wedding with Veena, he and Diya decide to elope with the help of their four close confidante cousins.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: At Manu’s wedding, the cousins search for a missing Diya. She arrives and kisses Manu on stage, shocking the families and creating chaos at the wedding, revealing hidden history.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: The cousins reunite at another wedding after ten years. Though Manu feels out of place, the others pull him back into the group and slowly try to rebuild their frayed bond.

videos.title: The Beach Story
videos.overview: Manu insists Diya show him the beach. A casual beach outing turns dangerous when Manu nearly drowns, and Diya is forced to rescue him.

videos.title: Ashwathy's CD
videos.overview: Ashwathy gets a mysterious CD that sparks Diya's curiosity. What begins as a secret plan to watch it alone creates chaos when the cousins find out, turning into a comic showdown.

videos.title: The Hard Goodbye
videos.overview: As the wedding celebrations end, the cousins face an emotional goodbye. Manu's attempt to confess his feelings to Diya goes awry, leaving them to part ways on uncertain terms.

videos.title: Four Years Later
videos.overview: At another wedding, adulthood reshapes identities. Old feelings resurface when Manu meets Diya again. New rival Prajith enters, determined to impress her and disrupt emotions.

videos.title: Disco Diya
videos.overview: A playful mishap sparks old childhood memories. As Prajith boldly pursues Diya, Manu finds himself torn between confidence and self-doubt over his feelings.

videos.title: The Family Video
videos.overview: The cousins collaborate on a wedding video project. Prajith manipulates the elders to present himself as Diya’s ideal match, intensifying rivalry as Manu silently grows uneasy.

videos.title: Onam Games
videos.overview: Festive games revive childhood chemistry. Prajith tries to impress Diya but fails when he cheats. Manu’s calm composure earns Diya’s admiration, melting the emotional distance.

videos.title: Marriage Talks
videos.overview: The elders subtly push Prajith as Diya’s groom. Family interviews unexpectedly expose old property disputes, revealing unresolved generational tensions beneath celebrations.

videos.title: Old Photos
videos.overview: Family conflicts escalate but resolve through emotional conversations. Manu and Diya share an honest discussion about life, marking a turning point in emotional openness.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: While Sanskriti seeks answers about Manu, Prajith tries to open up to Diya about his feelings. Will their search for the truth bring them closer or strain their relationships?

videos.title: The Roast Disaster
videos.overview: After Prajith hacks Chandu's computer, a roast video plays during the wedding, sparking a major family feud. As tensions rise, Megha boldly confronts the elders.

videos.title: Silent Rift
videos.overview: Chandu and Ashwathy clash over personal matters, driving a wedge between them. On the other hand, Manu is disheartened when he notices Prajith and Diya together.

videos.title: Confession Plan
videos.overview: Manu's plans to confess his love take a dramatic turn when Diya uncovers the truth about the two-timing. Elsewhere, Nima is left shaken after learning the truth about Chandu.

videos.title: Cousins Who Meet at Weddings
videos.overview: Diya tells Manu they should stay like cousins who meet at weddings. The fractured group drifts apart, but Chandu comforts Manu, promising things will mend by the next wedding

videos.title: The Problem Wedding
videos.overview: The cousins return for the next wedding, older now and carrying the weight of things life has taught them. But, this gathering feels different, a threat looms over the celebration.

videos.title: Old Wounds, New Love
videos.overview: Manu's old wounds with his mother reopen as she arrives for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya stays glued to her phone with Jay, her new lover, as Manu watches in silence.

videos.title: Love Coach Chandu
videos.overview: Manu can't bear losing Diya. Chandu steps in as his love coach, training him Chandu-style to win her back. Meanwhile Prajith returns and is back to his old antics.

videos.title: Two Slaps and a Brawl
videos.overview: Chandu's coaching backfires. At the mall, Megha slaps Joshy for harassing the girls. When Manu defends Megha, his mother slaps him to avoid another family rift, and he storms out.

videos.title: The Walk Back
videos.overview: Diya finds Manu alone at a shop. When he opens up about his loneliness and beliefs in marriage, she silences a call from Jay. They share a tender evening under the stars.

videos.title: Unsettled
videos.overview: While Manu and Diya find a new rhythm, Megha drifts away from the cousins, as she gets blamed for Manu's walkout. Meanwhile, the antagonists quietly regroup to stop the wedding.

videos.title: In Her Defence
videos.overview: Diya defends Ashwathy when a relative's wedding proposal sparks a sharp remark from her. Meanwhile, Chandu falls for Roshini, and Megha quietly makes peace.

videos.title: Highs and Loss
videos.overview: A surprise terrace party leads to emotional confessions while Manu and Chandu dodge chores. Things take an unexpected turn when an intoxicated Diya pulls Manu towards her.

videos.title: A Ride to Remember
videos.overview: Diya persuades Manu to take her to Nakshathra Thadakam. Amidst an exchange of heartfelt conversations, Manu is suddenly jolted by an unexpected call from Sanoop.

videos.title: Police Chaos
videos.overview: Diya and Manu engage in a deep conversation about Manu's family. Tensions rise as Chandu's group and the groom set to marry the next morning are arrested for drunk driving.

videos.title: D-Day Duels
videos.overview: Fun chaos breaks at the registrar office on the wedding day while Manu teases Diya that she said she likes him. Chandu then learns a shocking revelation about the girl he likes.

videos.title: Wedding Night
videos.overview: The roadblock turns into a celebratory convoy of relatives. Sanoop's first-night preparations descend into hilarious chaos as his cousins relentlessly tease him.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: As Sanoop's wedding celebrations wind down, everyone begins to leave. At the bus stand, Manu finally confesses his feelings to Diya, but she rejects him in favour of Jay.

videos.title: End of Days and Rays of Hope
videos.overview: Prajith is preparing to get married but faces a significant challenge, Covid. Despite the restrictions, guests arrive to celebrate him while following safety precautions.

videos.title: Social Distancing
videos.overview: Prajith's lockdown wedding spirals into socially distanced chaos and masked photos. Just as Manu plans an early escape, an unexpected twist gives him a reason to stay.

videos.title: Quarantine 'Tharavadu'
videos.overview: Locked in the ancestral house, the cousins turn quarantine into a reality show under Prabhakaran's command. A late-night confession round brings long-buried heartbreaks to light.

videos.title: Ceasefires
videos.overview: As Manu and Diya call an uneasy truce, Megha's secret relationship raises alarm among the cousins. Meanwhile, a prank on Aswathy's online class pushes her to a breaking point.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Ashwathy finds her fire again. Restless in quarantine, Chandu, Manu and Diya sneak out for a night in town. But the adventure spirals into a police chase through empty streets.

videos.title: The Ambulance Ride
videos.overview: Stranded after a curfew, Manu and Diya find an unlikely ride home in an ambulance. As they laugh through the fear, the old walls between them finally begin to crumble.

videos.title: The Balcony Confession
videos.overview: A football injury leaves Diya hurt and humiliated. On a quiet balcony at night, Manu finally opens his heart to her and a single moment changes their relationship forever.

videos.title: A New Day
videos.overview: Free of her past, Diya embraces a new beginning and helps Megha break away from Shaan. But as quarantine nears its end, she realises that she isn't ready to let this world go.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: On their last night together, the cousins celebrate. Manu and Diya share a dance to remember. But one conversation the next morning threatens to end their story before it begins.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Three years on, life has moved forward for everyone except Diya, who seems withdrawn since her mother's death. Coaxed to attend a wedding, she comes face-to-face with Manu again.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Manu and Diya navigate an awkward reunion while old family tensions resurface. As Haldi preparations begin, secrets simmer beneath the cousins' laughter and chaos.

videos.title: Stealing the Show
videos.overview: Veena's Haldi ceremony turns into a battle of egos as the cousins scramble to save face. Diya's unexpected performance stirs up feelings no one saw coming.

videos.title: Juice and Judgment
videos.overview: A prank meant to embarrass Veena spirals into public humiliation. Manu finds himself torn between duty and feelings he can't quite bury.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Fallout from the prank threatens to unravel the wedding, forcing Manu into a confrontation that tests just how far he'll go to keep the peace.

videos.title: Cracks Before the Sangeet
videos.overview: As the sangeet nears, tensions rise over Megha's troubled relationship and old rivalries. A devastating message pushes Manu closer to a dangerous breaking point.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: As celebrations continue, family conflicts boil over and Manu spirals further into heartbreak, leaving the cousins scrambling to hold things together.

videos.title: The Long Way Home
videos.overview: A raw, unfiltered night on the road forces Manu and Diya to finally confront everything left unsaid between them… and everything they still can't say.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: In the dead of night, Diya makes a decision that could change everything; one that puts her, Manu, and the family's fragile peace on the line.

videos.title: The Elopement
videos.overview: A daring plan sets the cousins into motion as Diya and Manu chase one last chance at the life they never got to have.

videos.title: Back to the Kiss
videos.overview: Diya's world comes crashing down as the day takes a turn no one could have predicted and the cousins are left to pick up the pieces.

videos.title: Three Years Later
videos.overview: With the past behind her, Diya has built a quiet life away from everyone. But a familiar face and a cousin gathering bring old memories rushing back.

videos.title: Old Photographs, New Beginnings
videos.overview: An old photograph reopens wounds Diya thought she had buried. Amid a lively shopping spree for Megha's wedding, the cousins reunite, with Diya eventually joining them for dinner.

videos.title: One Night, Not Yet Ready
videos.overview: As Megha's big day draws closer, a tearful reunion and a tense family meet test just how ready Diya really is to let this family back into her life

videos.title: Athirappilly
videos.overview: The cousins gather for another wedding. Old wounds and new beginnings collide against the stunning backdrop of Athirappilly.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: Family loyalties are tested as old grudges resurface and a shocking threat forces the cousins to close ranks around one of their own.

videos.title: Confronting the Truth

videos.title: Love Beyond Limits

videos.title: Discussion on Higher Education

tamil-series.name: Bigg Boss
tamil-series.description:
Many contestants live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Every week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction.

📺 Streaming on: OTT / Streaming
📅 Latest Episode: 2026-09-27
⭐ Rating: 3.7/10

videos.title: The Boss Is Here!
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan Kamal Haasan takes us on a tour of the well-equipped Bigg Boss House. Get set to be amazed as he introduces the contestants!

videos.title: Who's The House Leader?
videos.overview: The contestants choose their leader on their first day in the Bigg Boss House. Who is it?

videos.title: Snehan Takes The Lead!
videos.overview: Things have begun to heat up as the contestants need to nominate 2 vote-outs. Nominating Snehan to lead everybody, Bigg Boss has an exceptional task on hand. What is it?

videos.title: The Magic Of First Love!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss instructs the contestants to talk about their first love. Vaiyapuri and Namitha feel homesick, while Juliana suspects a cold war rising against her.

videos.title: The Drama Heats Up
videos.overview: The episode opens with another cat fight and Juliana's birthday celebration. The contestants have to tag their soulmates in the primary task of the day.

videos.title: First Bigg Boss Tamil Awards!
videos.overview: The contestants are told to get ready for their first Bigg Boss Tamil Awards, based on their performances in the past few days. Will this create unrest?

videos.title: Week One Review With Bigg Boss
videos.overview: Bigg Boss reviews the first week with the contestants and mentions of an elimination which is due next week.

videos.title: First Elimination!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan tells Anuya and Juliana which contestants voted against them and announces the name of the eliminated contestant. Also, watch the contestants enact songs from Kamal Haasan's movies!

videos.title: A New Leader Is Chosen
videos.overview: The contestants choose their new leader and give their elimination nominations for the week. Who is the leader now?

videos.title: Bigg Boss Says 'Recite Tamil Anthem'!
videos.overview: The contestants are told to recite the Tamizh Thaai Vaazhthu, which ends in a dispute between Gayathri and Juliana!

videos.title: New Set Of Challenges
videos.overview: The contestants get an interesting task of dedicating proverbs to each other. Who will impress Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Twists And Turns In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns Snehan to give tongue-twisters to each contestant but the real twist comes when Juliana makes a decision!

videos.title: Big Boss Annual School Festival
videos.overview: Will Gayathri’s request to Bigg Boss for chocolate powder be accepted? Meanwhile, Bigg Boss asks Snehan to organise an annual school function with a skit and a singing and dance performance. Who will shine?

videos.title: Who Is Next?
videos.overview: Adding to the drama, Kamal Haasan surprises everyone with a no elimination episode. He questions the contestants about the Bigg Boss school and Juliana's fight. The housemates are given a task to shop food items. Who will leave the house this week?

videos.title: Unexpected Turn Of Events!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss contestants are stunned when Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant. Why are they surprised?

videos.title: Bharani's Dramatic Escape Attempt
videos.overview: A frustrated Bharani tries to escape from the house by jumping over the wall. Will the Bigg Boss evict him?

videos.title: Virumaandis In The House!
videos.overview: The contestants dress up as Kamal Haasan's movie character, Virumaandi and dance whenever the songs assigned to them are played. Later, Bigg Boss punishes Aarav and Raisa. Why?

videos.title: Contestants Become 'Superstars'!
videos.overview: The contestants become Superstar Rajinikanth's movie character Padaiyappa and rock the house. Bigg Boss asks Ganesh to predict the order in which his fellow contestants are going to get evicted!

videos.title: Thala-Thalapathy Fever
videos.overview: As part of today's task, the contestants dress up like superstars Ajith and Vijay and perform a dance marathon!

videos.title: Juliana Is The Hot Topic
videos.overview: The drama quotient increases exponentially as Juliana becomes the topic of discussion among the housemates. Namita has two days to learn Tamil, while Razia and Snehan quarrel over the food.

videos.title: Raiza Bears The Brunt
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes Raiza for her frequently speaking in English. Kamal Haasan asks some challenging questions to the contestants. Will it create unrest in the house?

videos.title: A Dramatic Eviction
videos.overview: Amidst tension, Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. What does Bharani say about his escape attempt?

videos.title: Who Will Rule The House?
videos.overview: Shakthi, Oviya and Namitha compete in an endurance challenge to be the new leader. Who will get to rule the house?

videos.title: A Thief In The House?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a character to each contestant and asks them to protect a diamond from being stolen. But, who is the thief?

videos.title: The Hunt Begins!
videos.overview: The contestants learn that the diamond has been stolen and try to find the thief. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Tamil Thalaivas In The House
videos.overview: Tamil Thalaivas, Tamil Nadu's Pro Kabaddi League team visit and play a Kabaddi match with the Bigg Boss housemates. Later, the joy in the house disappears when Juliana falls ill!

videos.title: Nine Against One?
videos.overview: Namita and Gayathri ask the other contestants to stand with them against Oviya. The contestants compete in a fast food challenge.

videos.title: Kamal Reveals Oviya's Truth
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan makes each contestant understand the issue involving Oviya.

videos.title: Eviction Creates Confusion
videos.overview: As Kamal Haasan prepares to announce the name of the evicted contestant, Gayathri and Juliana rejoice assuming that there is no eviction this week. But is it true?

videos.title: Who Will Win?
videos.overview: Juliana tries convincing Aarav that Oviya is lying. Later, Aarav and Snehan compete in an interesting game to become this week's leader.

videos.title: Cycling Task Irks Vaiyapuri
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks assigns a cycling task to the contestants but Vaiyapuri isn't happy about it. Why?

videos.title: Oviya, Gayathri Become Reporters
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks Oviya and Gayathri to become news reporters and interview all the housemates. How will this change things in the house?

videos.title: Who Is The Jr Bigg Boss?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants by reducing their luxury budget points and assigns a task to select the Junior Bigg Boss of the house. Who will it be?

videos.title: Oviya, Juliana Clash
videos.overview: As part of a task, Juliana assigns Oviya to put out a red carpet for her. But, it ends in a fight. How?

videos.title: Kamal Sets Things Right
videos.overview: The contestants enact a scene from the movie "Avvai Shanmugi" with a motive. Kamal Hassan sets things right between the contestants.

videos.title: Welcome The New Contestant
videos.overview: Secrets are revealed as everyone gets a chance to talk for each other and answer Kamal Hassan's questions. A new contestant enters the house. Who is it?

videos.title: Shock Treatment!
videos.overview: Bindu Madhavi has a task for everyone that makes them run. Bigg Boss gives everybody a task of giving someone a shock treatment. Who is the bait?

videos.title: Oviya Isolates Herself
videos.overview: Oviya sleeps outside the living area, doesn't participate in the tasks, and snubs other contestants. Meanwhile, Aarav continues to avoid her. Will someone solve her problems?

videos.title: Oviya Wants To Leave
videos.overview: Bigg Boss organises a tug of war in the house. An unstable Oviya says that she wants to leave the house. Will she?

videos.title: Oviya Exits!
videos.overview: The crowd gives a massive reception to their favourite as Oviya leaves the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Another Departure!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan speaks personally to each contestant about the incidents that led to Oviya's exit and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who will it be?

videos.title: A Surprising Decision!
videos.overview: After asking the contestants to give their eviction nominations for the week, Bigg Boss stuns everyone with an announcement. What is it?

videos.title: A Battle On The Cards
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams with separate luxury budget points, based on their performance. Will it create a conflict?

videos.title: Unrest In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns some contestants with an alternative task as they are unhappy with the laundry task. Someone gets scared after the task is performed. What happened?

videos.title: Who Is The Lucky One?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that one of the contestants can be saved from eviction and asks them to cast their votes. Later, there's a rift between Gayathri and Raiza.

videos.title: Elimination Advantage Challenge
videos.overview: A thief and clown gain entry into the house and do their best to disturb everyone. Each contestant has to answer 5 questions to gain advantage in this week's elimination. Who will win this task?

videos.title: Sathish And Sripriya Visit
videos.overview: Actors Sathish Krishnan and Sripriya visit the show with questions for Bigg Boss on his elimination strategy and situation handling with contestants and more.

videos.title: Whose Turn Is it?
videos.overview: The contestants aren't in a mood to celebrate the 50th day in the house as Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant!

videos.title: Open Nominations
videos.overview: The contestants compete in a game to become the leader for the week. Bigg Boss asks each contestant to give their eviction nominations in the presence of others!

videos.title: Ghost In The House?
videos.overview: The contestants give a short speech about India, on the occasion of Independence day. Later, Snehan and Aarav try to scare Bindu. What's their plan?

videos.title: Another Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: Raiza is annoyed with Vaiyapuri's behaviour. Later, a new contestant enters the house as a wild card entry. Who is it?

videos.title: A Surprising Entry!
videos.overview: Snehan and Bindu play a prank on Suja. Gayatri and Aarav are mad at Snehan. Later, the contestants are in for a surprise as a new member joins them.

videos.title: VJ Kajal In The House
videos.overview: Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are unhappy after the rice packing challenge. Later, VJ Kajal makes a dramatic entry. Is she in the house to stay?

videos.title: Kamal Loses His Cool
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan lashes out at the contestants for disrespecting Bigg Boss and decides to speak only to the newcomers. Later, the contestants answer some controversial questions from the viewers.

videos.title: Who Leaves This Week?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan questions the housemates regarding the nominated contestants Raiza and Gayathri and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Later, there are some controversial questions aimed at the evicted one.

videos.title: Who Is The New Leader?
videos.overview: The newcomers compete in an exciting game to become the leader for the week. Later, the contestants give their eviction nominations!

videos.title: A Nomination Chain!
videos.overview: Aarav gets nominated for next week's eviction after pressing a buzzer but has a chance to transfer his nomination. How?

videos.title: Raiza In Trouble Again!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants for sleeping during the day and seeks an explanation from Raiza for the same. Meanwhile, Bindu has a tough task ahead.

videos.title: Killers In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the contestants that there are two killers in the house and assigns Vaiyapuri and Kajal the task to catch them. Who are the killers and what's their modus operandi?

videos.title: Double Murder Mystery
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes the housemates to the Bigg Boss Wrestling Federation. Ganesh and Raiza are killed by the mysterious killers. Are the others safe?

videos.title: The People's Court
videos.overview: The killers reveal themselves after two more murders. Some housemates get a chance to confront others, the legal way.

videos.title: Surprise Or Shock?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan stuns everyone by introducing a new pattern for conducting the eviction. Does he have more surprises up his sleeve?

videos.title: Unexpected Visitors!
videos.overview: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week. Later, they are astonished when two guests arrive at the house!

videos.title: Madurai Team Vs NRI Team
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the housemates into 2 teams and asks them to compete against each other. But, the first task itself creates some problems!

videos.title: Shift Of Power!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that the Madurai team will gain control of the house and NRI team members should serve them. Later, Julie gets grilled about her equation with Oviya and Aarav.

videos.title: Wedding Bells in The House
videos.overview: Harish and Bindu get married but have to compete with Aarav and Suja to succeed in their marriage. Aarav gets hurt during the task. Will Harish win?

videos.title: Bindu is Punished!
videos.overview: Bindu is punished for delaying in doing a task Bigg Boss assigned to her. Aarthi and Juli argue when Bigg Boss asks them to decide the winning team.

videos.title: An Attempt to Prank Kamal
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the contestants to enact some scenes that happened in the house and also asks them to play a prank on Kamal Haasan. Will the housemates succeed?

videos.title: It's Eviction Time!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. Aarav is arrested and taken out by masked men in black, but one masked man stays in the house. What's the plan?

videos.title: Leader Election
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces a new method to choose the leader for the week. Later, the housemates submit their eviction nominations. Who will get maximum votes?

videos.title: The Boss Says 'Stop'
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces an interesting task called 'Freeze and Release'. Later, Juliana gets annoyed by something that Aarthi does.

videos.title: Bigg Boss' Surprise!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss continues the 'Freeze and Release' task and gives heartwarming surprises to Vaiyapuri, Bindu and Harish. Later, an endurance task creates tension in the house!

videos.title: Loved Ones Visit!
videos.overview: Snehan finds it difficult to control his tears when his father comes all the way from his village to see him. Ganesh also receives a delightful surprise!

videos.title: Sweet Surprise for Aarav and Suja
videos.overview: Aarav and Suja are happy when some visitors take them by surprise. Bindu loses a bag of chocolates. Did someone steal it?

videos.title: Vishnu, Catherine in the House
videos.overview: Actors Vishnu Vishal and Catherine Tresa stun everyone with their surprise entry and claim to be the new wild card entries. Are they?

videos.title: A Surprise for Suja
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces that Harish and Bindu are safe. Later, he asks Suja to come out of the house. What's in store for her?

videos.title: Aarav Leads The Way
videos.overview: Bigg Boss chooses Aarav as this week's leader. The housemates are surprised to see Suja back in the house. Later, they give their eviction nominations for the week.

videos.title: Ticket to The Finale!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives the housemates an endurance task to win points and secure the ticket to the finale. Looks like the real fight has just begun!

videos.title: Snehan, Suja Won't Give Up
videos.overview: As Snehan and Suja refuse to end the task, Bigg Boss toughens up the rules. After hours of endurance, will the two finally give in to Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Housemates In Knots
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to form pairs, tie each other and free themselves from a complicated knot, as part of the ticket to finale task. Later, they show their artistic talents!

videos.title: All for a Ticket to the Finale
videos.overview: The men wear Bindu's dress, do a ramp walk and dance around the house. The housemates express themselves to win points and the ticket to the finale.

videos.title: Steal and Win Points
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the housemates to steal things from other housemates and drop it in a basket for points. Harish, Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are nominated for eviction.

videos.title: Kamal In the House
videos.overview: Kamal goes inside the house to hand over the Golden Ticket to a surprise winner. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who is it?

videos.title: Fight to Escape Eviction
videos.overview: Bigg Boss says that everyone, except Snehan is nominated for this week's eviction and gives them a way to escape. Later, a task turns a tad bit violent.

videos.title: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next Ticket to the Finale?

videos.title: Angels Vs Demons
videos.overview: The contestants divide themselves into teams of angels and demons for the second part of the Ticket To Finale tasks. What are they supposed to do?

videos.title: Role Reversal
videos.overview: As Aarav, Harish and Bindu fail to open the locker, Bigg Boss asks the demons to become angels and vice versa. Will the new demons win?

videos.title: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next ticket to the finale?

videos.title: Kamal's Important Announcement
videos.overview: The contestants are assigned various tasks with eggs hanging from their necks! Kamal Haasan makes an important announcement regarding the Finale points. What is it?

videos.title: Who Will Snehan Save?
videos.overview: Snehan can save Ganesh or Suja from eviction by giving his points to them. Who will be the lucky one?

videos.title: Actress Anjali Visits
videos.overview: The housemates give a grand welcome to the gorgeous actress Anjali, from the upcoming movie Balloon. What exciting tasks will she come up with?

videos.title: Dance Marathon is Back!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to dress up like movie characters and dance whenever the song assigned to them is played. Later, Snehan gets emotional thinking about leaving the house.

videos.title: Bigg Boss Makes a Tempting Offer
videos.overview: Bigg Boss offers a huge amount of money to the housemates to leave the house immediately. Will anyone take the bait?

videos.title: The Last Eviction!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss arranges an award function for the housemates. Find out who among the last 5 contestants get evicted.

videos.title: Freeze to Get Surprises!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss brings back the Freeze And Release task to give the housemates some delightful surprises. Snehan writes a brilliant song about their stay in the house!

videos.title: Aarav or Snehan?
videos.overview: After the finalists celebrate with evicted participants, Ganesh Venkatraman and Harish find themselves out of the house. The contest is then between Aarav and Snehan. Who will be the winner of Season 1 of Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Kamal Haasan Kickstarts Season 2
videos.overview: Superstar, Kamal Haasan kickstarts the show with sixteen interesting housemates eager to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house. Watch 'The Legend' get the ball rolling, however, with a twist in the tale.

videos.title: Day 1 in the House
videos.overview: Three candidates, one captain. Who among Janani, Mumtaz and Mahat will take charge as the first captain of Bigg Boss Season 2?

videos.title: Day 2 in the House
videos.overview: Problems are many and Janani desperately needs to prove her mettle as a captain. Will she succeed amidst all the luxury budget ruckus?

videos.title: Day 3 in the House
videos.overview: The shackles have come off and the first ever argument breaks out among the contestants. Watch Nithya's adamant demeanour turn her into the villain of the house.

videos.title: Day 4 in the House
videos.overview: A major rule violation has led to the contestants losing a significant part of their budget. What did they do?

videos.title: Day 5 in the House
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Janani kiss while Mumtaz and Bhalajie wear diapers and act like kids. All is not well between Mumtaz and Nithya. Janani is asked to name the underperfomers after three housemates are applauded for their efforts.

videos.title: Day 6 in the House
videos.overview: From the contestants' first-week experiences to Nithya and Mumtaz's onion fiasco, Kamal Haasan is here to peel it all out, layer by layer. Watch the drama unfold.

videos.title: Day 7 in the House
videos.overview: A happy ride takes a dramatic turn when Kamal Haasan brings the eviction back into focus. Who will pack their bags?

videos.title: Day 8 in the House
videos.overview: From being dominating personalities to their inability to handle a joke, the seniors are facing backlash, every step of the way. Are they being targeted for elimination?

videos.title: Day 9 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz and Mamathi turning rebellious has created an unrest during the master-servant task. Witness the ruckus in its purest form where solution is just a far-fetched idea.

videos.title: Day 10 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz disobeys Bigg Boss's order to wear her mic. Aishwarya and Yashika's raunchy dance has the men at the edge of their seats.

videos.title: Day 11 in the House
videos.overview: The tides have turned as the roles in the master-servant task have been reversed. From the husband-wife rivalry to Daniel's arrogance, witness the struggle as the house becomes an arena of total chaos.

videos.title: It's Men Vs Women!
videos.overview: A task has the housemates debating over who plays an active role in maintaining a relationship, men or women? What happens when the task ends up in an argument between two people of the same gender?

videos.title: Fake, Faker, Fakest!
videos.overview: On the brink of eliminations, the tensed housemates are in for a nail-biting session as Kamal Haasan exposes their two-faced nature, one by one.

videos.title: Groove Before You Move!
videos.overview: A groovy night comes to a screeching halt as Mamathi, Ananth and Mumtaz face their judgment day. Amidst the symphonious celebration with Kamal Haasan and Shruti Haasan, who's living their final moments in the house?

videos.title: Wrong Path to Captaincy!
videos.overview: On their run for captaincy, one amongst Vaishnavi and Senrayan reveals the secret task assigned to them. Will it result in a disqualification?

videos.title: Injustice in the House?
videos.overview: The new luxury budget task is testing Vaishnavi's captaincy as she faces criticism for her unfair evaluation. Is she doing justice to her role?

videos.title: Mumtaz has a Upper Hand
videos.overview: In the heat of the luxury budget task, the housemates engage in fierce arguments while Bhalajie opts deception as the best tactic to win. However, Mumtaz is unlikely to be fooled.

videos.title: Mumtaz Proves Herself!
videos.overview: Birthday girl, Mumtaz shows that she is in it to win. Watch as she finishes the last leg of the luxury budget task with ease where the other contestants are struggling.

videos.title: A Conjecture of Separation
videos.overview: While some of the housemates gang up on each other over trivial issues, Bigg Boss sets the stage for the contestants to pour out their feelings for their loved ones.

videos.title: Kamal Haasan in Tears
videos.overview: The Universal Actor, Kamal Haasan sheds tears on stage, listening to Daniel's heartbreaking story. Amidst the overwhelming emotions, one among the nominated escapes eliminations.

videos.title: The Evicted Holds Authority!
videos.overview: As the door to reality slides open, Ponnambalam and Ananth take their final steps towards eviction. Who amongst the housemates will make an exit and win a chance to sentence a jail term?

videos.title: United for Ponnambalam
videos.overview: Anand's decision to send Ponnambalam to jail has the housemates begging Bigg Boss to reconsider the decision. Mahat, Yashika and Aishwarya's friendship is on the line as they are forced to make a tough decision.

videos.title: Ponnambalam's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: As the eager contestants buckle up for the upcoming task, the house decends into total chaos after Ponnambalam does something unexpected.

videos.title: Taking It Too Far!
videos.overview: A major breach of the rules in the task brings out the nasty side of the contestants. From cut throat arguments to a few housemates quitting the game midway, it's a bigg confusion in the house.

videos.title: Everything Has a Price
videos.overview: The luxury budget task has the commoners coming up with ingenious ways to make the others cough up money. Catch what happens when Bigg Boss gives the housemates a chance to resolve all their conflicts.

videos.title: Kadaikutty Singam in the House
videos.overview: Karthi and Soori's surprise visit to the house has the contestants in a festive mood. Catch the cast of Kadaikutty Singam as they join the housemates in a fun-filled game of dumb charades.

videos.title: Through Hunger and Poverty

videos.overview: Ahead of the finale, the finalists are worried and glum about the past week. Watch Kamal Haasan turn into a cheerleader to amp up the excitement.

videos.title: Season Premiere
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan sets the ball of entertainment rolling as he returns with a new season of the greatest reality show! Stay tuned as he welcomes the housemates to the BB house.

videos.title: Day 1: And The Game Begins

videos.overview: Housemates wrap up the icebreaker task while Aysha sheds tears in silence. The next day, chaos erupts in the house when BB asks them to share reviews about each clubs.

videos.title: Day 5: Feuds and Fun Tasks
videos.overview: Dhanalakshmi breaks down when Janany swaps her from the team. Later, the housemates participate in various tasks and gather to choose the best and worst performers of the week.

videos.title: Day 6: Kamal Meets the Housemates
videos.overview: After an exhaustive first week, Ulaganayagan greets the housemates with intriguing tasks and discusses the ongoing issues. He also gives a piece of advice to Dhanalakshmi and Shivin.

videos.title: Day 7: A Bigg Surprise for Housemates
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan hosts thought-provoking tasks to improve communication between the housemates. After his fun banter with GP Muthu and Kathirravan, he makes a shocking announcement.

videos.title: Day 8: The First Captain of S6
videos.overview: With a lot of excitement, Shanthi, Janany and GP Muthu compete for captaincy. As the new captain is elected, the housemates prepare for the next bigg task, their first nominations.

videos.title: Day 9: Oru Kadhai Sollatuma?
videos.overview: Housemates groove to the peppy tunes to secure the luxury budget. Later, they come forward to share their stories and save themselves from next week's nominations. Who will succeed?

videos.title: Day 10: A Fight To Get Saved
videos.overview: Shivin, Myna, and Kathir become the lucky ones to step into the nomination-free zone. Some feel cornered, while others fear for their chances to get saved.

videos.title: Day 11: An Uproar in the House
videos.overview: Dhanalakshmi flares at Asal for his comments and soon after, Vikraman's intervention creates a ruckus in the house. Meanwhile, GP Muthu steps into the confession room with a request.

videos.title: Day 12: Ranking Task Goes Awry
videos.overview: Housemates must withhold their ranks to qualify for captaincy and to escape BB Jail. However, things go south as Azeem-Aysha and Shanthi-ADK get into high-octane fights.

videos.title: Day 13: What Will GB Muthu Decide?
videos.overview: When asked to vote, Azeem gets the maximum number of red cards from the housemates. Kamal tries to have a heart-to-heart conversation with GP Muthu. Will he leave the house?

videos.title: Day 14: Kamal's Special Task and Eviction
videos.overview: Along with some interesting tasks and discussions, Kamal asks the housemates to vote for the one who is deviating from his/her game plan. Who will leave the house today?
