videos.overview: Queency, Maheshwari and ADK compete for the next captaincy, while the nomination intensifies the tension. Later, all the housemates gear up to celebrate Diwali in BB house.

videos.title: Day 16: Save or Steal the Dolls
videos.overview: For today's challenge, the housemates have to secure a spot on the shelf for their dolls and save themselves from getting eliminated from the task. Who will win the task?

videos.title: Day 17 - A Verbal War in the House
videos.overview: After a change in the rules of the task, the housemates get feisty and defend their positions. Soon, Dhanalakshmi and Azeem point fingers at each other when Sheriina gets injured.

videos.title: Day 18 - Who is at Fault?
videos.overview: Azeem's impulsive moves exasperate Dhanalakshmi, while his teammates start doubting his gameplay. Elsewhere, the three ladies take part in the individual luxury budget task.

videos.title: Day 19: Winner Takes it All
videos.overview: Amuthavanan, Ram and Robert emerge as winners of the task and get a special advantage. The housemates then vote for the best and worst performers. Who will land in which spot?

videos.title: Day 20: Kamal Confronts the Housemates
videos.overview: Kamal appreciates Shivin and moves on to clear the air between the housemates. Dhanalakshmi gets a "kurumpadam", while Azeem gets reprimanded for his acts.

videos.title: Day 21: It's Elimination Day
videos.overview: Kamal hosts mind-boggling tasks in which the housemates must pick other contestants and state their reasons. Later, he announces the eviction result. Whose journey will end today?

videos.title: Day 22: A Bittersweet Nomination
videos.overview: Queency, Manikanta Rajesh and Nivaashini compete in the Captaincy task. Later, the housemates step into the confession room for the weekly process. Who will get nominated this week?

videos.title: Day 23: TRP Depends on Performances
videos.overview: Split into teams of two TV channels, the challenge is to get the highest TRP ratings with exceptional performances in their respective shows. Will the judgement be fair?

videos.title: Day 24: Internal Conflicts
videos.overview: Dhanalakshmi and Azeem engage in a serious altercation while discussing the show plans for the next day. Further, the Makeover Task triggers a chain of chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 25: It's Showtime!
videos.overview: With interesting skits and acts, the teams showcase their talents to win higher rating points. During the News task, Maheswari's scores for Vikraman's team ensue a fight between them.

videos.title: Day 26: Who Will Get Highest TRP?
videos.overview: "Antha TV" and "Intha TV" showcase their serials and await the final TRP results. Later, the housemates are asked to select the best and worst performers. Who will that be?

videos.title: Day 27: Kamal's Special Advice
videos.overview: Azeem's change is behaviour is appluaded by the housemates. As each one gets judged for their contributions in TRP task, Kamal shares pieces of advice with Queency and Janani.

videos.title: Day 28: Kamal's Birthday Celebrations
videos.overview: Along with some fun tasks, Kamal gives the housemates a warning to mend their ways. As one of them packs to leave, the rest of the contestants wish Kamal in their unique way.

videos.title: Day 29: A Busy Day in the House
videos.overview: Housemates gear up for a variety of tasks and welcome their new captain. The situation turns sour as they engage in bitching sessions and squabbles after the nomination process.

videos.title: Day 30: A Scuffle in the Sweet Shop
videos.overview: When BB installs two sweet shops in the house, some contestants turn into confectioners and others become customers. Soon, chaos ensues when fights break out within the teams.

videos.title: Day 31: Fire and Hire
videos.overview: An array of arguments sets off in the house as the teams combat each other in the Factory task. Moreover, the shop owners lay off some workers and hire commoners.

videos.title: Day 32: Spicy Fights and Suspicions
videos.overview: ADK feels offended when Janany picks him as the housemate with a personality mask. Dhanalakshmi gets doubtful about Azeem's gameplay, while Vikraman feels targeted by Amudhavanan.

videos.title: Day 33: Meet the Task Winners
videos.overview: After a hard-fought battle, BB announces the winners of Factory task. Later, housemates gather to vote for the best and worst performers of the task and jail awaits the latter.

videos.title: Day 34: Kamal Shares His Views
videos.overview: It's that time of the week when Kamal meets the housemates for a reality check. Amidst the interesting tasks, he offers a piece of advice to Amudhavanan.

videos.title: Day 35: The Final Judgement
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan hosts a compatibility task for the housemates. Before he announces the evictee's name, he gives his verdict on Dhanalakshmi's victory from the Factory task.

videos.title: Day 36: A Day of Tears and Cheers
videos.overview: Housemates get competitive to secure this week's captaincy and later, take part in an intense nomination process. Meanwhile, Dhanalakshmi makes a heart-wrenching confession to BB.

videos.title: Day 37: BB Roast Fest
videos.overview: For the luxury budget, housemates take part in an engaging roast session in pairs. Later, the selection process for the Royal Museum task leaves everyone in splits.

videos.title: Day 38: The Royal Secrets
videos.overview: The commotion builds in the museum as the Royals get into an argument with servants and guards about their meals. Later in the day, two royal members receive secret tasks from BB.

videos.title: Day 39: Guards, Stay Alert!
videos.overview: A sudden theft of the treasure box keeps the guards on their toes. Now, they have to protect the museum and find the thieves. What will be their strategy?

videos.title: Day 40: An Emotional Roller Coaster
videos.overview: From ADK's never-ending dispute with Azeem to the revelation of the secret tasks, a lot is happening in the house today. In addition, a disappointed Robert breaks down into tears.

videos.title: Day 41: Kamal Addresses the BB Royals
videos.overview: Kamal is intrigued by the eventful Royal Museum task and shares a whole bunch of feedback and views with the housemates. Who will be the lucky ones to get saved today?

videos.title: Day 42: Sunday Special with Kamal
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan conducts stirring tasks and ADK gets a chance to present his rap. Later, housemates put Azeem in the spotlight when Kamal asks them to predict the evictee's name.

videos.title: Day 43: Dhanalakshmi vs the Housemates
videos.overview: Unable to accept her defeat in the captaincy task, Dhanalakshmi argues with the housemates and refuses to join her team. Later, BB commences the season's first open nominations.

videos.title: Day 44: BB Court Room
videos.overview: Housemates file their cases and hire lawyers to represent them at the BB Court. Don't miss the drama as housemates indulge in fiery debates and heated arguments.

videos.title: Day 45: Silence Please!
videos.overview: The BB court is in session with some controversial as well as some silly cases for the day. Will the judgments be passed in favour of the plaintiffs or their defendants?

videos.title: Day 46: Complaints and Clarifications
videos.overview: With new grievances, the judges witness high-octane fights between the parties in the court. Later, Queency rece

videos.title: Day 47: Final Verdict
videos.overview: The BB Court task comes to an end, and the housemates pick the best and the worst performers. Unaware of Kathirravan and Queency's act, Shivin tries to break them apart.

videos.title: Day 48: Don't Play Safe!
videos.overview: Housemates are tongue-tied when Kamal probes into BB Court task and the fairness of the judgments. Further, he gives a solution for Dhanalakshmi's captaincy issue.

videos.title: Day 49: A Special Occasion
videos.overview: Kamal hosts an intriguing Emoji task and gives the audience a chance to ask questions to the housemates. In the meantime, a surprise and eviction await the housemates.

videos.title: Day 50: New Day, New Captain
videos.overview: Captain Azeem takes charge of the house and assigns daily duties to everyone. After the fun yet frustrating nominations, BB stuns the housemates with a new task.

videos.title: Day 51: BB Aliens vs Tribals
videos.overview: Team Tribals and Aliens must enter each other's zones and endure the opponent's acts to win rewards. However, when things get personal, they indulge in ugly fights.

videos.title: Day 52: A Sneak Attack
videos.overview: Chaos ensues in the house when the teams execute their tactics on each other for rewards. With new rules, the task continues with housemates testing each other's tolerance.

videos.title: Day 53: Aliens vs Tribals
videos.overview: It's a bitter-sweet day for Azeem and Amudhavanan, involving an intense fight and teamwork. In version 3.0 of the task, the challenge is to win gems from the opponents.

videos.title: Day 54: Worst Performers Get a Surprise
videos.overview: The housemates turn against Azeem when he reveals that he stole the flowers. Everyone votes for the best and worst performers, but this time BB gives something different to the latter.

videos.title: Day 55: Hot Seat
videos.overview: Kamal gives the participants of the 'Reacting Chair' task a chance to question their opponents. Who will get summoned for this special Q and A round?

videos.title: Day 56: Rating and Eviction
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan asks the housemates to name the one who is two-faced in the house as well as gives them a rating task. Amidst these highs and lows, who will get eliminated today?

videos.title: Day 57: An Impressive Hat Trick
videos.overview: Manikanta stuns everyone by becoming the captain of the house for the third time. Amidst the fun and frolic, housemates gear up for the weekly nomination process.

videos.title: Day 58: Bigg Stars in BB House
videos.overview: For the new task, all the housemates adorn the movie characters assigned by BB. The better they perform, the more money they can collect from each other.

videos.title: Day 59: The Galatta Continues
videos.overview: The role-play task continues and the housemates showcase multiple performances to earn money. On the other hand, Dhanalakshmi and Janany discuss about favouritism within the house.

videos.title: Day 60: An Eventful Eve with Anjali
videos.overview: The cast of Fall make a surprise visit to the house and engage in interesting conversations. Later, housemates put aside their differences and take part in the BB Star auditions.

videos.title: Day 61: BBS6 Star Awards
videos.overview: After an impressive face-off between the Top 5 BB Star contestants, it is time for the results. Find out who wins the prizes and titles at the award ceremony.

videos.title: Day 62: A Shocking Eviction
videos.overview: Favouritism, task performances and judges' decisions - Kamal discusses the past week's conflicts with the housemates. Further, the first Saturday eviction leaves everyone baffled.

videos.title: Day 63: Hardwork or Luck?
videos.overview: Kamal and the housemates get sentimental as they engage in a conversation about their parents. Later, he asks them to recognise the hard-working players in the house with trophies.

videos.title: Day 64: A Hot Topic
videos.overview: The housemates get busy as the new captain reassigns daily duties to everyone. Later, the hot-headed Kitchen team retaliates when they receive complaints from the housemates.

videos.title: Day 65: A Difficult Challenge
videos.overview: The members of Team Hell put their best foot forward to win the tasks and enter the "Heaven" zone. Soon, a huge argument breaks out between Azeem and Amudhavanan.

videos.title: Day 66: The Angel's Choice
videos.overview: Myna calls Amudhavanan out for being biased towards Janany. During the Shortcut task 2.0, the Angels are asked to name the Demons who could become the Top 3 finalists.

videos.title: Day 67: ADK's Emotional Outburst
videos.overview: The teams put aside their differences and swap their members for the next round. However, ADK argues with Azeem and refuses to accept Team Hell's decision.

videos.title: Day 68: The Best Entertainers
videos.overview: The Shortcut task comes to an end, and some housemates enter the nomination-free zone. Later, they gather to choose the "Best" and the "Boring" players of this season.

videos.title: Day 69: Fair or Unfair?
videos.overview: Kamal asks the housemates about this week's game strategies and shares a piece of advice. Soon, they go into shock when he presents a "Kurumpadam" about Vikraman-Janany's issue.

videos.title: Day 70: Eviction Drama
videos.overview: The housemates rank themselves out of 10 and discuss the luxury task with Kamal. Soon, tension rises as they inch towards the elimination process. Who will exit the house?

videos.title: Day 71: An Incredible Win
videos.overview: Manikanta breaks all records to become the BB house captain for the fourth time. On the other hand, the open nomination ends with an intense discussion between Myna-Amudhavanan.

videos.title: Day 72: Back To School
videos.overview: For the new task, the housemates adorn the characters of school teachers and naughty children. An emotional ride begins when they start sharing their childhood memories and dreams.

videos.title: Day 73: A Letter to Your Loved One
videos.overview: After a long day at BB school, everyone gathers to select the best students and teachers. Later, the housemates burst into tears when they read out their special letters.

videos.title: Day 74: Rewind Retro
videos.overview: Housemates bring back the 80s style and enthusiastically take part in fun skits and classes. Soon, their joy is cut short as they sit down for individual interview sessions.

videos.title: Day 75: Ranking Task
videos.overview: Chaos ensues as housemates fight for the first position in the Ranking task. Who will secure the highest ranks and who will receive punishment?

videos.title: Day 76: A Stern Warning from Kamal
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan reviews the Ranking task and grills Azeem about his behaviour with other housemates. Later, he hosts some compelling tasks that lead to thought-provoking discussions.

videos.title: Day 77: Kamal Gets Nostalgic
videos.overview: Kamal recollects some notable instances from School task and speaks about his special letter. Soon, tension over the eviction grips the nominated ones. Whose journey will end today?

videos.title: Day 78: Red or Green Card?
videos.overview: Housemates issue cards of different colours to each other for this week's nomination. Later, a confused Myna approaches Vikraman while others enjoy the Christmas feast.

videos.title: Day 79: Family Fiesta
videos.overview: One of the most awaited moments, the family week, is finally here. Near and dear ones of the housemates bring in some happy surprises, while BB adds twist to the celebration.

videos.title: Day 80: Housemates, Freeze!
videos.overview: Housemates cannot contain their excitement as their loved ones visit the house with special tasks. In addition, Manikanta gets overjoyed as Aishwarya Rajesh and family surprise him.

videos.title: Day 81: Mixed Emotions
videos.overview: Vikraman, Azeem and Kathirravan welcome their special ones and enthusiastically participate in the tasks. Amidst the fun, Shivin feels overwhelmed and gets teary-eyed.

videos.title: Day 82: Housemates Get Defensive
videos.overview: In today's task, each contestant takes the dias to answer two crucial questions and the others react by going for or against them. The situation intensifies as the task proceeds.

videos.title: Day 83: The Yellow Card Dispute
videos.overview: The weekend begins as housemates recollect the Family task and share their sentiments with Kamal. Later, the yellow card ignites a heated argument between Azeem and Amudhavanan.

videos.title: Day 84: New Year, New Friendships
videos.overview: Kamal celebrates the new year with the housemates and hosts a heartwarming task. Before the eviction process, he gives them a chance to share their thoughts with him.

videos.title: Day 85: A Quirky Q&A Task
videos.overview: Azeem loses this week's captaincy to ADK, but he earns the chance to get exempted from the nomination. Later, housemates face each other in a spellbinding Questions and Answers task.

videos.title: Day 86: Ticket to Finale
videos.overview: The competition gets fierce as the much-awaited "Ticket to Finale" week begins. With new twists and strenuous tasks, the housemates battle it out to win maximum points.

videos.title: Day 87: A New Dispute
videos.overview: ADK shares his criticism about other contestants with Myna. Later in the day, an argument erupts between Azeem, Shivin and Rachitha when he gets eliminated from the group task.

videos.title: Day 88: Trouble over Tasks
videos.overview: The Cycle task continues and so does the disagreement between the housemates. In addition, Azeem stirs up a storm while picking an opponent for one-on-one challenges.

videos.title: Day 89: BB Critics Awards
videos.overview: Amudhavanan secures the ticket and becomes the first finalist of the season. Afterwards, the housemates gather for the sensational award ceremony. Tune in to find out the winners.

videos.title: Day 90: Guess Who
videos.overview: Kamal probes into this week's captaincy and assesses Azeem's remarks against Shivin and Vikraman. Soon, he hosts a game in which the housemates must give bitter tags to each other.

videos.title: Day 91: Kamal's Wise Counsel
videos.overview: After learning about the housemates' opinion of Azeem, Kamal advises them to look beyond his shortcomings. To lessen the eviction tension, he conducts the 'Finish the Story' game.

videos.title: Day 92: Nominations for One Last Time
videos.overview: The result of the Captaincy task stuns everyone, while the season's final nomination causes turmoil in the house. Amidst this, Suresh and Ahmed Meeran visit them with clues.

videos.title: Day 93: Special Guests and A Dare
videos.overview: BB challenges the housemates with individual dares and asks them to complete it. Later, VJs Shobhana and Parvathy visit the house to give an insight into the audience's opinions.

videos.title: Day 94: BB Roleplay
videos.overview: BB welcomes some of the ex-contestants to surprise the housemates. In today's unique task, everybody gets a chance to become Bigg Boss for a day. ADK is the first one to go.

videos.title: Day 95: An Exciting Reunion
videos.overview: Housemates get overjoyed as ex-contestants visit them in the house. Later, Shivin, Kathirravan and Vikraman take turns to step into BB's shoes and conduct some interesting tasks.

videos.title: Day 96: New Tasks for the Top 7
videos.overview: When Robert and Azeem fight over the latter's offense, BB gives a stern reminder to all. Sacrifice 2.0 begins and the ex-contestants come up with fun dares for the housemates.

videos.title: Day 97: It's Reward Time!
videos.overview: After all the daring sacrifices, the finalists get a sweet surprise from Kamal. Amidst the enticing discussions, he gives yet another challenge to the housemates.

videos.title: Day 98: Best Select of BBS6
videos.overview: Kamal gives the housemates a chance to express their guilt and gratitude. As each contestant votes for the best one of the season, who will bid goodbye today?

videos.title: Day 99: Pongal Celebrations
videos.overview: Pongalo Pongal! BB house has lit up for the harvest festival celebrations. Special guests join the housemates for fun games and activities to make the event even more spectacular.

videos.title: Day 100: BB's Enticing Offer!
videos.overview: Maheshwari and Manikanta's fight creates a stir, but Rachitha and Aysha's entry lightens the mood. Bigg Boss finally sends in the money bag. Will the finalists accept it and leave?

videos.title: Day 101: Money Box is Back
videos.overview: Keeping their grudges aside, housemates start forming new friendships. As the ex-contestants start bidding goodbye, BB offers yet another exciting offer to the finalists.

videos.title: Day 102: Reliving the Happy Days
videos.overview: The housemates take a walk down their memory lane as BB shows them their journey AVs of the whole season. Amudhavanan and Myna are the first ones to go.

videos.title: Day 103: Mid-week Eviction
videos.overview: Housemates are in a shock as one of the finalists walks away with the money box. In addition, BB gathers them for a mid-week elimination. Who will be the top 3 finalists?

videos.title: Day 104: The Last Day
videos.overview: As the D-day is around the corner, finalists Shivin, Azeem and Vikraman prepare themselves and campaign for one last time! To cheer them up, Kavin visits BB house with his co-actors.

videos.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The moment we all have been waiting for is finally here! Tune in for some scintillating performances and find out who emerges as this season's winner with Kamal Haasan.

videos.title: Season Premiere

videos.title: Day 1: First Eviction of S8
videos.overview: Aatam Pudusu! This season's journey begins with an eviction, followed by another nomination. With no time to relax, the housemates buckle up for their first captaincy.

videos.title: Day 2: Swap Your Teammate!
videos.overview: In a new twist of the day, BB asks the Men's and Women's teams to swap one member each. As the teams argue to agree, they are presented with the ration list for shopping.

videos.title: Day 3: Fiery Fights
videos.overview: Muthu crosses the border for water and gets into an argument with the men's team. Another round of verbal war erupts in the house, which gets heated up in the debate task.

videos.title: Day 4: Who Is a Better Parent?
videos.overview: The housemates are asked to predict the next evictee, while BB assigns a new debate topic. Later, Soundarya gathers everyone to clarify some comments about the morning activity.

videos.title: Day 5: The Nomination Free Pass

videos.title: Day 6: Vijay Sethupathi Meets the House

videos.title: Day 7: Housemates in a Dilemma

videos.title: Day 8: Captaincy and Nominations
videos.overview: It's a day of decisions! The teams are asked to pick contenders for captaincy as well as new members to swap. As one battle ends, nomination begins, but with a condition.

videos.title: Day 9: No Room for Mistakes
videos.overview: Men's team manage to lose their weekly budget, while the Women's team crosses borders without permission. Chaos ensues when these issues are settled alongside the new rules.

videos.title: Day 10: King TV vs Queen TV

videos.title: Day 11: A Neck and Neck Task
videos.overview: The housemates pull up their socks to win the "Nomination Free Pass". Later during the dinner preparation, Darsha feels cornered. What happened in the kitchen?

videos.title: Day 12: Victory for Women's Team
videos.overview: The Award ceremony goes for a toss, while the women's team skillfully win the Nomination Free Pass. Later, the housemates are asked to vote for the best and worst performers.

videos.title: Day 13: Applauds from VJS
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates some of the housemates for their good conduct. With a quirky question for Arun and a special task for Muthu, he signs off by advising the Men's team.

videos.title: Day 14: VJS Debunks the Accusations
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan leads an open Q and A with the housemates, during which Arnav challenges Dharsha over her accusation. Later, they discuss Sathya's captaincy and this week's eviction.

videos.title: Day 15: Team Swap Trouble
videos.overview: Ranjith, Tharshika compete for captaincy, while Soudarya fails to convince the women's team for the swap. As candidates are chosen for switching, mixed nominations raise the heat.

videos.title: Day 16: First Guests of BB Hotel
videos.overview: Arun unintentionally crosses the border to which the women's team put forth a deal. In the hotel task, the men's team complains against the management, leading Pavithra to resign.

videos.title: Day 17: Role Reversal in the Hotel
videos.overview: The men's team takes charge as staff and the women's team as haughty guests. The ladies succeed in taking revenge, and later everyone gears up for a game of dumb charades.

videos.overview: After a review session, both teams vote for the best and worst performers. BB announces the results with a twist, and the hotel gets set to welcome their new guests and staff.

videos.overview: Women's team win the 'Nomination Free Pass' and have a debate among them to decide who deserves it. Later, all the housemates gather to welcome Sivakarthikeyan to the house.

videos.title: Day 20: VJS Reviews the Gameplay
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan recalls last week's events and commends the 'guests' of BB hotel. He probes the fairness of the Killer Coin task and raises issues of inequality among the girls.

videos.title: Day 21: Housemates on the Hot Seat
videos.overview: VJS commends housemates for their Hotel task and probes for any bias in assignments. He resolves all disputes while assessing team-swapping decisions ahead of eviction.

videos.title: Day 22: New Week, New Strategies
videos.overview: As the week begins, team swapping and captaincy tasks are in full swing. Nominations raise tension while collecting ration points and shopping add fuel to the fire.

videos.title: Day 23: Rolling for Role Play
videos.overview: As the women's team lose, they take up all the household tasks. Next, the housemates enact each other's characters as per BB's instructions, raising the bar of entertainment.

videos.title: Day 24: Reel Ones Review the Real
videos.overview: The housemates get a reality check from their "task characters". After the Showtime, Vishal talks about Muthu's game plan while the women win the float or sink task.

videos.title: Day 25: Kavin's Diwali Surprise
videos.overview: Decked up in traditional attires, the housemates celebrate Deepavali with fun games, crackers and a special lunch. The merriment doubles when Kavin enters the house.

videos.title: Day 26: Women's Team Wins Again
videos.overview: The women’s team earn 'Nomination Free Pass', while Jeffry and Sachana receive penalties for their performance this week. Later, Sathya and Ananthi go head-to-head for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 27: Celebrating in Style with VJS
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan spreads festive cheer with his greetings and asks about the outfits he gifted the housemates. He reviews this week's tasks and the women’s team's success streak.

videos.title: Day 28: Make Way for the Wildcards
videos.overview: VJS asks Muthu about his captaincy review and offers guidance. Moreover, the arrival of new contestants and a Diwali 'bonus' from VJS leaves the housemates feeling bittersweet.

videos.title: Day 29: The First Open Nominations
videos.overview: Captain Sathya takes charge and assigns duties, while the direct nominations raise tension. Chaos ensues when Tharshika puts forth a condition for the Men's team.

videos.title: Day 30: Triumphs and Troubles
videos.overview: Men's team won the tasks, yet the border crossing debate remains unresolved. Following the unfair discussions, the women's team declare a hunger strike, leading to a verbal war.

videos.title: Day 31: Identify the Manipulator
videos.overview: The housemates are asked to vote for the most manipulative ones among them. Men secure their first Nomination Free Pass, while the story task continues without any interruptions.

videos.title: Day 32: Letters on the Way
videos.overview: Harsh nicknames and anonymous criticisms from each other, leaves the housemates wounded. Later, everyone celebrates Ulaganayagan's birthday before resuming the storytelling task.

videos.title: Day 33: Best and Worst Selection
videos.overview: The women get a task of styling the men. Additionally, BB asks the housemates to vote for the best and worst performers, while Arun secures the captaincy title this week.

videos.title: Day 34: Weekly Review
videos.overview: VJS asks housemates and wildcards about their opinions on each other, offering advice to both teams. Moreover, he dives deep into Sathya's leadership and Women's team's new rules.

videos.title: Day 35: An Advice from Makkal Selvan
videos.overview: VJS revisits the highlights of the weekly task, and emphasises the need to address behavioural challenges. Later, he offered advice to some and resolves ongoing tiffs.

videos.title: Day 36: New Rules for the Captain
videos.overview: Captain Arun is clad with a powerful cape, while the women's team dominate the shopping task. After nominations, the men panic as they fail to notice their new member Anshida.

videos.title: Day 37: Back to School
videos.overview: Excitement runs high as housemates become teachers and mischievous students for this week’s BB School task. But with clashes erupting at every corner, can order be restored?

videos.title: Day 38: Scuffles and a Secret Task
videos.overview: Feedback from students leaves the staff frustrated, while Deepak receives secret task by BB. Later, the teachers struggle to maintain order as fiery arguments erupt in the school.

videos.title: Day 39: Chaos at School
videos.overview: Students protest against Principal Varshini’s harsh actions. On the other hand, Jacquline is left in tears after Deepak and Arun misinterpret her words.

videos.title: Day 40: Captain Arun Faces the Heat
videos.overview: After losing stripes from his cape, Captain Arun mediates a dispute within the women's team. The best performers become captaincy contenders, while the worst face a penalty.

videos.title: Day 41: VJS Issues a Progress Report
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan receives feedback on the school task and student disruptions. Later, Deepak’s revelation surprises many in the house, while others clarify misunderstandings.

videos.title: Day 42: Eviction Drama and a Twist
videos.overview: VJS discusses Arun's captaincy and warns the housemates about their refusals and behaviour. After the eviction, he delivers an unexpected surprise to everyone.

videos.title: Day 43: A Costly Mistake
videos.overview: After a tearful argument with Arun, Manjari takes charge as the captain. Later, a crisis unfolds when the women’s shopping task goes wrong and they lose everything.

videos.title: Day 44: Conflict Sparks Mayhem
videos.overview: Sachana gets emotional after the women's team confront and advises her. Later, Raanav clashes with Manjari over a rule violation, while Muthu challenges her leadership.

videos.title: Day 45: BB Darbar
videos.overview: The house splits into two kingdoms - ruled by King Raanav and Queen Sachana. To claim the throne, they must conquer tasks, but what happens when unexpected hurdles arise?

videos.title: Day 46: Arimadesam Takes the Lead
videos.overview: Teams guess time and weight without gadgets to score points for the throne. The men bag a victory hat-trick, while the women prepare to fight back and take back what's theirs.

videos.title: Day 47: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: This week’s best performers compete for captaincy, while Soundarya and Shiva face harsh criticism. One is brought to tears, whereas the other attempts to clear the air with Deepak.

videos.title: Day 48: VJS Investigates the Issues
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates about changes after the house swap and their task experiences. Later, he probes into concerns over Sachana’s penalty task and Manjari's leadership.

videos.title: Day 49: Halfway to Finale
videos.overview: The housemates open up about their milestones, the shopping mistake and the challenges in the Darbar task. Later, VJS delivers an announcement that fills everyone with excitement.

videos.title: Day 50: One Bigg Team
videos.overview: Captain Deepak's proactive efforts win him praises from BB. Though the nomination process causes friction between the housemates, an unified shopping task brings them together.

videos.title: Day 51: Doll Task
videos.overview: Anandhi and Pavithra's confrontation leaves Anshida emotional. Later, the quirky Doll task spirals out of control when housemates resist placing the dolls.

videos.title: Day 52: Traits, Talks and Tasks
videos.overview: The housemates make peace with the previous day's results, while an unwashed cup causes a stir. Match the traits activity sets in, and BB resumes the Doll task with fresh rules.

videos.title: Day 53: Disputes Over the Dolls
videos.overview: Sachana's hasty decision to cut one of the captain's roses leads to an argument. Later, a series of heated tiffs arise after Rayan and Raanav lock horns to secure the dolls.

videos.title: Day 54: Special Guests and Squabbles
videos.overview: Child artists of the Hotstar Specials show Parachute, visit the house. Later, Manjari raises a food issue with Arun, and the argument intensifies when Captain Deepak gets involved.

videos.title: Day 55: From Controversies to Captaincy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan probes the housemates on this week's issues, from the Arun-Manjari fallout to Sachana’s unacceptable walkout. Later, he applauds captain Deepak.

videos.title: Day 56: VJS Reviews the Doll Task
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi discusses about the Doll task in detail. Strategies, gameplays and fights are questioned, while the nominated ones prepare for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 57: New Leaders Step In
videos.overview: Jeffry and Sachana are appointed captain and vice-captain respectively. The quirky shopping task stirs frustration, while Arun and Manjari resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 58: Ranking Task with a Twist
videos.overview: After a morning activity on activeness, the housemates rank each other based on their goodwill. Tables turn when BB declares the top eight as Angels, and the rest as Demons.

videos.title: Day 59: Angels vs Devils
videos.overview: Intense emotional stress and physical challenges in the task lead the Angels to cry and argue. Meanwhile, the Devils face growing tensions within their ranks.

videos.title: Day 60: Role Reversal Round
videos.overview: BB asks the Devils to declare the count of hearts collected, and begin the next round by swapping roles. Angels of round one get set to take revenge.

videos.title: Day 61: Whom Would You Choose?
videos.overview: After intense arguments for the Nomination Free Pass, the housemates choose their friends and foes. The worst performers get punished, while the best compete for captaincy.

videos.title: Day 62: Rules or Rebellion?
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi offers a mix of praise and advice on the housemates' roles as Devils and Angels. He questions the fairness of the Goa Gang's rules and their impact on the game.

videos.title: Day 63: Double Eviction
videos.overview: VJS discusses Jeffry’s leadership, ration concerns and task conflicts. The atmosphere shifts dramatically when he announces the unexpected double eviction.

videos.title: Day 64: Stuck with the Label
videos.overview: Captain Ranjith faces a housemate's dissatisfaction during his first task. Rayan and Arun engage in a mockery feud, while housemates wear badges with labels from nominations.

videos.title: Day 65: Managers vs Labourers
videos.overview: Arun and Deepak argue, after which the housemates pick the top and bottom contestants, leading to heated exchanges. Next, the manager vs labourer task creates chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 66: Swap! Swap! Swap!
videos.overview: Heated altercations ensue over team swaps between Managers and Labourers. Later, as Muthu's actions lead to a ban, the Managers punish him for his behaviour.

videos.title: Day 67: New Rules, New Conflicts
videos.overview: 2.0 of the task begins with some twists and changes, making labourers incharge of the household chores. Commotion ensues when the teams clash and rules get violated.

videos.title: Day 68: Vidhuthalai 2 Team Pays a Visit
videos.overview: Amidst the celebrations and conflicts, Raanav gets nominated while Jeffry wins the Free pass. The best-worst performers are selected, and special guests surprise the housemates.

videos.title: Day 69: Mind-bending Questions from VJS
videos.overview: A twist in the tale occurs as VJS decides to begin the day with an eviction. He addresses the housemates' concerns and some of his questions make them rethink their decisions.

videos.title: Day 70: VJS Checks on the Housemates
videos.overview: Ranjith's captaincy is discussed in detail, after which VJS advises him to change his approach. As one more housemate bid goodbye, the rest have a one-on-one discussion with VJS.

videos.title: Day 71: Captaincy and Open Nominations
videos.overview: Raanav's unexpected move in the captaincy task changes the dynamics, resulting in Vishal's victory. Post-task arguments and open nominations escalate tensions in the house.

videos.title: Day 72: Bricks and Bruises
videos.overview: Fierce arguments and clashes erupt as housemates fight to secure and steal bricks for the task. Moreover, tension builds when Raanav’s injury triggers strange speculations.

videos.title: Day 73: Team Tiffs
videos.overview: Raanav’s exit forces a reshuffle, while foul play allegations hit Jeffry’s team. Amid the chaos, Captain Vishal succumbs to the mounting pressure during the task.

videos.title: Day 74: Muyal 2.0
videos.overview: Three teams battle intensely to catch the most rabbits and claim the NF pass. Problems arisewhen the women engage in physical struggles and sharp exchanges.

videos.title: Day 75: BB Revokes Benefits
videos.overview: Jacquline receives an audience-assigned task that leaves her in tears. Contender Muthu’s gameplay during the task upsets BB who then makes shocking announcements.

videos.title: Day 76: Applauses with a Dose of Advice
videos.overview: VJS commends the housemates for their efforts in the weekly task. Later, he interrogates those who questioned Raanav’s injury and highlights the red team's performance issues.

videos.title: Day 77: Who Will Join VJS Onstage?
videos.overview: The housemates vote for the "Attenion-seeker" while VJS delves into the details of Vishal's captaincy. Muthu gets an earful for his behaviour, and everyone preps for the eviction.

videos.title: Day 78: Bigg Buzz Over the New Chef
videos.overview: Housemates get emotional as they talk about who they miss. After Soundarya cooks solo, BB announces no kitchen help from now on, sparking lively debates on future cooking duties.

videos.title: Day 79: Family Week
videos.overview: Emotions overflow as Deepak, Manjari and Rayan reunite with their families. Vishal’s joy doubles when his loved one unexpectedly makes an entrance.

videos.title: Day 80: Emotional Surprises
videos.overview: Soundarya, Raanav, Pavithra, and Anshida’s families arrive with surprises and reveal their concerns. In the midst of this, Soundarya and Jacqueline resolve their differences.

videos.title: Day 81: Happy Reunions
videos.overview: Arun’s sadness fades as BB reveals his prank and brings in his parents. Jeffry, Jacquline and Muthu’s families enter shortly after, turning the house into a whirlwind of happiness.

videos.title: Day 82: Support and Surprises
videos.overview: As tough weeks approach, the housemates' friends bring advice and encouragement. Arun is overjoyed to see Archana, while Erode Mahesh boosts the morale of all the housemates.

videos.title: Day 83: Saturday Eviction
videos.overview: VJS asks housemates about their family interactions and their thoughts on the contradictions shared. Later, the house is left in shock as he announces an unexpected eviction.

videos.title: Day 84: Ticket to Finale
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan prompts housemates to share new year resolutions and call out the least deserving of votes. Following an eviction, he reveals the much-anticipated Ticket to Finale.

videos.title: Day 85: And the Games Begins!
videos.overview: Open nominations lead to unrest in the house, while Soundarya and Muthu clash over shopping preferences. Later, BB kick-starts TTF week with the first quirky task.

videos.title: Day 86: A Tough Fight
videos.overview: The TTF challenge heats up with two tough tasks. Muthu and Raanav get into an altercation, while two others score points—who are they?

videos.title: Day 87: New Year, New Challenges
videos.overview: Muthu, Jacquline and Soundarya find housemates to execute their Phone tasks, but each face failure. Later, BB hosts a special New Year’s dinner with a twist.

videos.title: Day 88: Deals and Disputes
videos.overview: The scoreboard turns upside down after the Ball task. Manjari strikes a deal with Rayan, while the Points Mandrum task causes chaos in the house.

videos.title: Day 89: One Last Call
videos.overview: Arun and Rayan compete to pick up the last call from BB, while Soundarya and Raanav engage in a heated argument. Meanwhile, the top TTF scorers battle it out in the final round.

videos.title: Day 90: VJS Questions the Strategy
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan asks the house who they believe does not deserve the TTF and why. Further, he analyses the impact of alliances in the game, with Muthu admitting to his errors.

videos.title: Day 91: Meet Your First Finalist
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates on who they think deserved to stay in the game. Moments later, the house erupts with excitement as he enters the house to announce the TTF winner.

videos.title: Day 92: Wildcard Knockout!
videos.overview: Soundarya sobs from the criticism, while the wildcard announcement leaves the house in panic. However, the situation lightens when they get a task to roast the ex-housemates.

videos.title: Day 93: It's Time for Feedback!
videos.overview: Ex-contestants of S8 re-enter, go through the task comments, and review the rest of the housemates, leading to chaos. Some take it sportingly, while Vishal feels overwhelmed.

videos.title: Day 94: Top 8 vs Challengers
videos.overview: Dressed as movie characters, housemates battle with the challengers in Aadiya Aatam Enna task. Minor scuffles draw attention, but BB’s strict warning leaves the wildcards in a fix.

videos.title: Day 95: Dance Battles
videos.overview: Soundarya breaks down after the top 8 and challengers nominate each other for position swaps. Later, the house buzzes with energy during the one-on-one dance showdown.

videos.title: Day 96: Clashes and Confrontations
videos.overview: Deepak's words hurt Varshini, and besties Soundarya and Jacquline have a heated argument that puts their friendship at stake. The housemates battle in the final round of the task.

videos.title: Day 97: A Surprise Eviction
videos.overview: VJS appreciates the character performances of the housemates. He also discusses the reactions and reviews of the ex-contestants and reveals the first evictee of this week.

videos.title: Day 98: An Unexpected Elimination
videos.overview: The housemates share a memory they wish to erase, and VJS discusses the animosity that the ex-contestants came in with. The eviction results sweep everyone off their feet.

videos.title: Day 99: Reunions Cause Chaos
videos.overview: BB declares that the challengers failed to replace the finalists and applauds the top six. The rest of the ex-contestants step in one by one, creating a stir in the house.

videos.title: Day 100: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The housemates happily celebrate Pongal with BBS5 winner Raju and other special guests. The much-anticipated money box has arrived, but with a twist. Will someone claim it today?

videos.title: Day 101: Ma Ka Pa in the House!
videos.overview: BB brings in the second money box, and Rayan accepts the challenge to retrieve it within a set time. Ma Ka Pa surprises the housemates and hosts an entertaining podcast with them.

videos.title: Day 102: Final Race for the Money Box
videos.overview: The next four of the top six try their luck with the money box today. The housemates warmly welcome some special guests, including their beloved Manjari, Raanav, and Deepak.

videos.title: Day 103: Let's Rewind
videos.overview: The housemates are enthralled with the video compilations of their special bonds and bigg fights of this season. Later, the top five finalists get to relive their journey of S8.

videos.title: Day 104: The Last Day in BB House
videos.overview: All the housemates together have a blast, with BB's farewell speech being a cherry on top. Later, the ex-contestants convey their wishes and bid goodbye to the finalists.

videos.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: Five contenders, one trophy and an ultimate showdown! Join Vijay Sethupathi as he crowns this season's winner in an evening of captivating entertainment.

videos.title: BBTam: Grand Launch
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns with a new season that’s bold, unpredictable, and dripping with drama. Let the chaos begin!

videos.title: BBTam Day 1: Water Woes in the House
videos.overview: With water running low, in-charges from Normal and Super Deluxe houses come under fire. Later, the season's first nominations begin with a twist.

videos.title: BBTam Day 2: Rules Broken, Roles Swapped
videos.overview: Ramya breaks down after a heated fight, and the housemates face punishment after Kani breaks a kitchen rule. Later, Nandhini, Kemy and Diwakar share their stories.

videos.title: BBTam Day 3: The Battle for Captaincy Begins
videos.overview: The captaincy task Ponguthey Ponguthey kicks off and housemates face early challenges. Tensions flare when Paaru refuses to clean, sparking clashes and emotional moments.

videos.title: BBTam Day 4: Taps Dry, Tempers High
videos.overview: After Kamrudin oversleeps and misses water, BB and housemates confronts the water monitors. Thala Task 2 begins, and Aadhirai, Kalaiyarasan and Praveen Gandhi share their stories.

videos.title: BBTam Day 5: Fake Fights, Real Tears
videos.overview: The Super Deluxe members are left fuming after a prank by the kitchen team. Later, the announcement of the first Thala leaves Aathirai upset, while Nandhini turns to BB for help.

videos.title: BBTam Day 6: A Reality Check with VJS
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi demands accountability for this week’s water task mess, questions housemates’ roles and addresses Watermelon Star’s comment. Later, he asks them to spot the fake.

videos.title: BBTam Day 7: Season’s First Eviction
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan puts the spotlight on the housemates’ powers and their fanbase status. After the first eviction, a surprising twist with the water tank cheers up the housemates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 8: From Noise to Nominations
videos.overview: Hungry housemates stir chaos by waking Super Deluxe members with noise and sabotaging their meal. Nadigan Da Nadigan Da task ends with a swap, and so the nominations begin.

videos.title: BBTam Day 9: Bommai Battles
videos.overview: Paaru's act in the kitchen triggers Thala’s warning and a kitchen strike. Later, the first rounds of the weekly task Bommai Bommai end early as Kemy and Paaru get eliminated.

videos.title: BBTam Day 10: Strong Defenses and Old Scores
videos.overview: The Bommai task restarts with a twist, sparking a massive clash between the houses over the game and stolen onions. Later, Ramya shares her emotional life story.

videos.title: BBTam Day 11: Thala's Downfall
videos.overview: After fierce clashes and chaos, the Bommai task ends, granting one housemate immunity. Later, Thala Tushaar and the house face stern warnings for rule violations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 12: Captaincy Contenders Face-Off
videos.overview: Kani and Sabari are picked as the best performers, while Aathirai and Aurora are sent to jail. The Kuthunga Yajaman Kuthunga task sparks a heated argument among the contenders.

videos.title: BBTam Day 13: Truth or Tactics?
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates Kani’s captaincy win and questions Kamrudin's performance in the task. Later, he probes the Bommai task strategies and asks about two-faced housemates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 14: Happy Deepavali
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi starts with festive cheer, teasing Vinoth and Watermelon Star about their fights. He then questions Tushaar’s captaincy and raises food and salt issues.

videos.title: BBTam Day 15: Festive Vibes in the House
videos.overview: Housemates celebrate Diwali with a Tamil-style oil bath, followed by nominations and a house swap. Dhruv Vikram, along with Team Bison, joins them for the festivities.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: BB Juice Factory
videos.overview: A tea-time clash sparks tension between FJ and Paaru. Super Deluxe faces friction with the other team, while juice task planning stirs fresh conflicts.

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: House Drama Over Cleaning Duties
videos.overview: FJ, Kemy, and Paaru argue over cleaning duties, sparking tensions in the house. Meanwhile, the Juice Factory task intensifies with QC disputes.

videos.title: BBTam Day 18: Coins Amid the Chaos
videos.overview: BB awards factory owners with coins for approved bottles. QC monitors face pressure from workers, while one housemate takes the lead and reaps the rewards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 19: The Best and the Worst
videos.overview: Paaru's emotional breakdown leads to arguments when Watermelon Star intervenes. The best and worst performers are chosen, while FJ and Aathirai lock horns

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Attention, Housemates!
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi slams the housemates for toxic behaviour and serves bitter gourd juice as a reality check. He probes their task performance and issues stern warnings.

videos.title: BBTam Day 21: Housemates Spill the Tea
videos.overview: Housemates discuss problems during Kani’s captaincy. Subiksha, Viyana and Praveen are saved, while VJS asks who is not performing well, before eviction process.

videos.title: BBTam Day 22: The Day the House Lost Everything
videos.overview: A new captain is chosen, and a swap task is held. Tensions rise as Kani and Paaru clash. After nominations, BB drops a massive twist, taking away all belongings for a hard reset.

videos.title: BBTam Day 23: The Army Rule Rebellion
videos.overview: BB takes all food and essentials. Captain Praveen's army rules spark a clash with Paaru. Arguments erupt with Vinoth and Diwakar during the locker task, leaving the house divided.

videos.title: BBTam Day 24: Non-stop Drama
videos.overview: Watermelon Star clashes with housemates over acting lessons. Tensions ease as the team aces the locker challenge before a surprise visit from team Aan Paavam Pollathathu.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Tug of Words
videos.overview: An array of arguments unfolds when Watermelon Star shares his grievances. BB housemates secure 1000 points, while the Yaar Antha Paiyan task gets interrupted by intense tiffs.

videos.title: BBTam Day 26: Lockers Open, Truths Spoken
videos.overview: FJ and Sabari share their life stories, and two housemates win a free pass. After a clash between Vikram and Diwakar, the Locker task ends in a twist and BB issues a demand.

videos.title: BBTam Day 27: VJS Addresses Groupism in House
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi opens the episode with a loudspeaker, scolding housemates for constant shouting. He questions Ramya and Sabari about groupism and warns against team play.

videos.title: BBTam Day 28: Wild Cards Enter the Game
videos.overview: Praveen faced criticism for his captaincy, prompting VJS to guide him on improvements. Later, VJS welcomed wild cards Prajin, Sandra, Divya, and Amit into the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 29: One House, One Rule
videos.overview: Divya becomes Thala after BB ends house divisions. Open nominations rattle the house, and contestants share their thoughts on the new wildcards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 30: Aaha Oho Hotel
videos.overview: Kamrudin, Prajan and Praveen’s prank ends on an emotional note. The Aaha Oho Hotel task kicks off with Priyanka, Manjari and Deepak’s arrival, bringing fun and drama to the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 31: Manager Under Fire
videos.overview: Manager Divya calls an urgent assembly, sparking a fight with Tushaar. Later, tensions during a staff meeting lead BB to announce a management change, voted on by the staff.

videos.title: BBTam Day 32: Hotel in Turmoil
videos.overview: Chaos hits the hotel as Sandra’s wild behaviour and secret spills rattle the guests. Overwhelmed by the turmoil, Manager Vikram gives up. Later, singer Mano visits BB house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 33: Rifts and Realisations
videos.overview: Spotlight shines on Paaru as concern turns to tears when she's crowned this week's best performer. While two land in jail, clashes ripple through the house after the selection.

videos.title: BBTam Day 34: All Eyes on the Wild Cards
videos.overview: This week’s conflicts and a controversial prank draw Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. He also puts wild cards under the microscope before unveiling this week’s eviction twist.

videos.title: BBTam Day 35: Weekly Recap
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi clears the air over the Hotel task drama and shocks everyone with Sandra’s secret mission. He confronts idle contestants before proceeding with an eviction.

videos.title: BBTam Day 36: Nominations and New Alliances
videos.overview: Aurora and Paaru’s clash turns emotional, after which a new Thala is elected. Wild cards aim to split Kani’s group and form a new alliance ahead of nominations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 37: Gana vs Tharbees Samrajyam
videos.overview: Thala Sabari steps in after a complaint from Watermelon Star stirs chaos in the Kitchen team. Later, kingdoms Gana and Tharbees ignite the royal task with special showcases.

videos.title: BBTam Day 38: The Clash of Samrajyams
videos.overview: Vikram and Paaru ascend the thrones, with Paaru addressing grievances against Watermelon Star. As tensions ease, the Samrajyams clash in the Kodi Parakuthu task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 39: Ranking Task Goes Awry!
videos.overview: Heated arguments and punishments shake the Royals task. Later, BB selects Kani, Amit and Vikram to rank housemates by maturity, sparking chaos and drama.

videos.title: BBTam Day 40: Fights and a Fallout
videos.overview: Viyana and Subiksha part ways, while BB punishes FJ for rule breaches. The house descends into chaos during the Worst Performer selection before the Captaincy Mathil task begins.

videos.title: BBTam Day 41: VJS Warns Against Blind Loyalty
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi highlighted mistakes in the task and warned Watermelon Star and Paaru against blind support. He later questioned FJ and Sabari for neglecting others’ injuries.

videos.title: BBTam Day 42: VJS Probes Task Abandonment
videos.overview: During the kingdom-task discussion, VJS questioned Watermelon Star about why he abandoned the task midway. He then asked all housemates about their 'protection shield

videos.title: BBTam Day 43: Special Guests and Selection
videos.overview: FJ becomes the new house Thala, while BB hosts a open-nomination that leaves the housemates perplexed. Later, they identify their competitors, and Team Nadu Center visit them.

videos.title: BBTam Day 44: Soru Soapu Mopu Task Kicks Off
videos.overview: BB housemates competed in the 'Soru Soapu Mopu' task across three squads, following their themed rules. FJ, Vinoth, and Amith later insisted the rules shouldn’t affect eating.

videos.title: BBTam Day 45: From Arguments to Achievements
videos.overview: The selection of the Star and Worst Performer leads to chaos, while Ramya and Kemy break down over the remarks. The Mop Mayavis take the lead in Konjam Paatu Konjam Point task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 46: Only One Team Stands Tall
videos.overview: Team clashes and kitchen walkouts spark tension as captains and housemates argue their way through the week. Poornima’s visit brings brief joy before one team emerges victorious.

videos.title: BBTam Day 47: Kavin Shows Up with a Surprise
videos.overview: Sandra and Divya face penalty as the week’s worst performers. Prajin clashes with Vikram over harsh remarks, and Kavin enters the house with a twist - mid-week eviction.

videos.title: BBTam Day 48: No Mercy for the Wildcards!
videos.overview: Delays, comments and team choices put Sandra and Divya under Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. Moreover, Prajin faces a hard-hitting reality check post weekly task's analysis.

videos.title: BBTam Day 49: Half-Century, Full Surprise
videos.overview: Marking 50 days, VJS questions the housemates on who surprised them by making it this far. He probes nomination strategies, sparks eviction drama and hints at a mystery surprise.

videos.title: BBTam Day 50: A Reality Check from Home
videos.overview: Viyana and Divya clash over sugar. Following nominations and the Saanja Pochu captaincy task, housemates receive gameplay tips via video messages from friends.

videos.title: BBTam Day 51: From School Bells to Star Visit
videos.overview: Class is in session at BB School! Kani teacher manages her naughty students, while Keerthy Suresh makes a stunning entry. Later, housemates gather for Amit's birthday bash.

videos.title: BBTam Day 52: Commotion in the Campus
videos.overview: Vikram’s haircut prank sparks chatter, Sabari explodes over food, and Amit criticises Viyana. Students share their views on hostel and school before protesting against staff FJ.

videos.title: BBTam Day 53: Uniforms Lost, Secrets Found
videos.overview: Vikram scolds Viyana for tearing the task letter before she’s hit with a humiliating penalty. Paaru’s missing uniform and a troubling letter about her and Amit leave her in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 54: A Day of Lessons and Penalties
videos.overview: Students explore the BB Museum while Viyana sits out for mischief. Later, Ramya and Prajin become the best performers, while FJ and Vinoth land in trouble.

videos.title: BBTam Day 55: VJS Evaluates Task and Attitude
videos.overview: VJS praised the housemates’ efforts in the weekly school task with a framed group photo. FJ was criticised for poor leadership, role mishandling, and a remark about Sandra.

videos.title: BBTam Day 56: Letters Unveiled, Bonds Shake
videos.overview: Housemates read their ‘Mottai Kadithasi’ letters, sparking laughter and fun. Later, the ‘Neetippu Thundippu’ task put friendships and rivalries to the test.

videos.title: BBTam Day 57: Heartfelt Talks to Heated Debates
videos.overview: FJ–Aadhirai and Aurora–Paaru resolve their issues, and a new Thala steps up. Post nominations, boys and girls clash in exciting debates. Who’ll emerge victorious?

videos.title: BBTam Day 58: Modern vs Retro Cinema Team
videos.overview: Paaru, Aurora and Kamrudin discuss their dynamics, while Vikram and Subiksha mend their rift. Later, Modern vs Retro teams challenge each other to protect the prized necklaces.

videos.title: BBTam Day 59: BB Schools the Housemates
videos.overview: Sandra and Subhiksha’s petty fight, along with a 'ghost' lurking in the house stirs unrest. BB blasts everyone for their lack of effort on the task, and a jewel theft follows.

videos.title: BBTam Day 60: Jodi Task Turns Turbulent
videos.overview: Sabari’s theft lands him in jail, Aurora breaks down over Paaru’s words, and FJ is kicked out. In the Jodi task, chaos erupts as teams clash with fights and fierce verbal wars.

videos.title: BBTam Day 61: Race to Escape
videos.overview: BB makes the house name six best performers and sends the others into jail. While arguments explode, the 10 jailed contestants try to save themselves. Who will stay behind?

videos.title: BBTam Day 62: Carelessness Exposed by VJS
videos.overview: VJS questioned Viyana on the bucket issue but dropped it after her confused answers. He then called out the housemates for ignoring their roles and being careless.

videos.title: BBTam Day 63: Recap with VJS
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan asks housemates to name who puts others down and digs into task clashes and grievances. Thala Ramya faces a sharp reality check before eviction begins.

videos.title: BBTam Day 64: New Week, Same Old Drama
videos.overview: Kamrudin’s harsh comments backfire when Aurora and Aadhirai confront him. Later, a new Thala is chosen, and the housemates participate in a new nomination process.

videos.title: BBTam Day 65: Secrets, Rules and Court Drama
videos.overview: Paaru and Kamrudin’s secret mic-free talk prompts BB to confiscate all essentials. The Vazhakkaadu Mandram task starts, while the BB court hears the tense Vinoth–Aadhirai case.

videos.title: BBTam Day 66: Court Dismissed!
videos.overview: The house decides on a punishment for Paaru and Kamrudin. Tension peaks as Aadhirai fights with Amit over FJ’s case outcome. The legal drama continues with Paaru taking on FJ.

videos.title: BBTam Day 67: Funny Trials and Kitchen Fights
videos.overview: Vikram pranks Subhiksha for singing and sues her in a funny trial. Aurora fights a case against Paaru, leaving the decision to the Audience. Later, kitchen duties spark a clash.

videos.title: BBTam Day 68: Chaos at the BB Court
videos.overview: The court trial turns chaotic with constant interruptions. FJ fights Kamrudin. Later, the worst performer is named and Divya clashes with Kamrudin.

videos.title: BBTam Day 69: House in the Hot Seat
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan kicks off by questioning Paaru and Kamrudin’s antics and calls out silent witnesses of his clash withDivya. Later, the house review Amit’s captaincy.

videos.title: BBTam Day 70: VJS Delivers the Verdict
videos.overview: Housemates are schooled by Vijay Sethupathi for poor court decorum as he reviews the cases. After Aurora speaks up against FJ, he earns a warning for his conduct.

videos.title: BBTam Day 71: New Captain, Colourful Nominations
videos.overview: The captaincy task crowns a new leader. Paaru clashes over duties as teams split. Nominations get colourful with paint, ending in tears for Sandra and Kani.

videos.title: BBTam Day 72: Dance Marathon 2.0
videos.overview: Teams battle it out in a dance marathon as BB announces a special prize. Later, fights erupt over eggs, and the teams manage to score points.

videos.title: BBTam Day 73: Low on Dance, High on Drama
videos.overview: A sleepless night ignites arguments and moral debates between Sandra and some housemates. During the Marathon, some shine with swift guesses while others struggle to find the beat.

videos.title: BBTam Day 74: Tears, Warnings and a Victory
videos.overview: Vikram and Subhiksha breakdown after receiving a warning from BB. Yemmadi Aathaadi team shines in the task while Sandra clashes with Kani over personal remarks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 75: No Apologies, Only Arguments!
videos.overview: Kani confronts Sandra while Paaru and Divya clash. The Captaincy task turns aggressive as FJ lashes out. Best and Worst performers are revealed amidst the chaos.

videos.title: BBTam Day 76: Vijay Sets the Record Straight
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupathi grills Sandra on her conduct and resolves Aadhirai and Vinoth’s issue. He reviews the captaincy and asks the housemates who is overshadowing whom.

videos.title: BBTam Day 77: Truths, Tensions and Two Evictions
videos.overview: Housemates cheer as Vijay Sethupathi spreads Christmas vibes along with Santa. Sandra faces questions again. Excitement builds for Family Week before shocking evictions.

videos.title: BBTam Day 78: Family Week 2.0
videos.overview: Kamrudin grabs the spotlight as his argument with Paaru intensifies, and he takes charge of the house. Nominations follow, and Sandra’s special visitors leave her deeply emotional.

videos.title: BBTam Day 79: Family Bonds and Fun Loops
videos.overview: Kani clashes with Amit amid emotional family entries. Vinoth’s wife cuts a birthday apple and advises him on his anger, while Vikram and Paaru enjoy the freeze loop.

videos.title: BBTam Day 80: Reunions and Reality Checks
videos.overview: Vinoth and Amit talk out their cooking conflict! Further, Divya and Amit meet their loved ones in the Family Week. Will reality checks change the gaming equation?

videos.title: BBTam Day 81: Friends, Family and Festive Fun
videos.overview: Secret Santa surprises the housemates with gifts and chocolates. Later, Paaru’s mother, Aurora’s friends, and Kamrudin’s family arrive, bringing joy and laughter.

videos.title: BBTam Day 82: A Day of Advice and Conflicts
videos.overview: Paaru's mom exits as Vikram and Subiksha’s families enter the house. Tensions flare as Divya clashes with Vinoth and Paaru over the sponsor task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 83: VJS Reacts to Family Week Fun
videos.overview: Housemates shared their views on which visiting family members impressed them most. VJS also reviewed changes after the family’s entry, captaincy, and the vessel-washing issue.

videos.title: BBTam Day 84: Top 10 Under the Spotlight
videos.overview: VJS applauds the Top 10 and asks them to name who might not deserve a finale ticket. Later, a fierce clash between Vikram and Divya shocks the housemates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 85: Ticket to Finale Begins
videos.overview: Housemates expose PR survivors. Kamrudin sparks a huge fight with Paaru over a sensitive issue, while the ultimate battle begins with the first Ticket to Finale task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 86: Drama Peaks In Ticket to finale task
videos.overview: The Ticket to Finale intensifies! Paaru and Kamrudin clash during the game. In the aftermath, Kamrudin apologizes for his outburst, while Vikram makes peace with Divya.

videos.title: BBTam Day 87: Task Victories Amidst The Drama
videos.overview: Paaru and Sandra discuss strategies. As the Ticket to Finale continues, Sabari and Paaru perform exceptionally well. Meanwhile, Divya clashes with Vikram after a tough task exit.

videos.title: BBTam Day 88: Coins, Chaos and Celebration
videos.overview: Sandra breaks down after fighting Kamrudin. Paaru rages against Vikram's Killer Coin task strategy. Later, the house celebrates with a New Year feast.

videos.title: BBTam Day 89: Secure Your Spot!
videos.overview: Aurora wins Task 7, and the final TTF challenge begins. Housemates squeeze into a car where tempers flare between Kamrudin and Sandra, while Paaru’s gameplay leads to an injury.

videos.title: BBTam Day 90: No More Warnings!
videos.overview: Housemates face intense questioning from VJS over the car task chaos, as he grills them on why no one stopped Paaru and Kamrudin. Later, the duo face the harsh reality.

videos.title: BBTam Day 91: Meet the First Finalist
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns to meet the contestants! Get ready for a rollercoaster of drama, laughter, emotions, and unexpected twists.

videos.title: BBTam Day 92: Panapetti 2.0
videos.overview: BB offers housemates a daring chance to save a nominee. Viyana’s entry and eviction drama triggers panic. Later, the housemates scramble to stack the cash in the money box.

videos.title: BBTam Day 93: Big Money Temptation Starts
videos.overview: Viyana targets Sandra while Praveen & Diwakar join the house. BB warns Diwakar. After tasks add cash to the pot, the Pana Petti opens! Will anyone take the money box and exit?

videos.title: BBTam Day 94: Top Six vs Evictees
videos.overview: Panapetti 2.0 task intensifies as housemates race to increase the prize money. Ramya and Apsara enter the house, and evictees battle it out to raise the pot.

videos.title: BBTam Day 95: Can The Final 6 Pull It Off?
videos.overview: The finalists must execute a secret mission to hide Kemy inside the house. Can they complete the multiple levels of the task unnoticed? Meanwhile, the LBW team enters the BB House.

videos.title: BBTam Day 96: Vinoth's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Drama brews with clashes between the Top Six and evictees before the Pulambinaa Panam task. Later, as Aurora reaches the money box, Vinoth drops a shocker that stuns the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 97: First Encounters, Final Farewells
videos.overview: VJS discusses the shift in dynamics between ex-housemates and finalists. A heartfelt farewell for Vinoth follows, as housemates recall their first interactions.

videos.title: BBTam Day 98: Chinna Kurumpadam, Bigg Twists
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan gives ex-housemates a shot to campaign for the finalists, while Kurumpadam uncovers drama. In a jaw-dropping twist, just 4 finalists survive and Sandra waves goodbye.

videos.title: BBTam Day 99: Finale Week
videos.overview: The Top Four light up as Amit, Kalaiyarasan, Prajin and Tushaar arrive. Misunderstandings between Aurora and Tushaar vanish, and the house gears up for the finale with fun tasks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 100: Celebrating the Bigg Milestone
videos.overview: The winning speeches of the finalists take center stage, while Aurora hands a letter to Tushaar. A prank by Kani and Subhiksha upsets Vikram, before housemates celebrate 100 days.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 101: Friendship, Fights and Feelings
videos.overview: Diwakar fights Divya. Sandra and Vinoth return, resolving issues and consoling Aurora. The house celebrates Bhogi and bonds over friendship memories.

videos.title: BBTam Day 102: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss house is buzzing! New tasks, wild missions, and explosive fights bring real drama and endless entertainment.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 103: A Blast from the Past
videos.overview: A fight compilation sparks a clash between Prajean and Diwakar. Sandy and Kavin visit for a movie promo and dance! Vikram gets emotional watching his journey video.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 104: The Final Night in the House
videos.overview: Divya, Sabari & Aurora relive their journeys. The Top four get a makeover for the finale. BB's touching words leave everyone in tears as ex-contestants bid a heavy-hearted goodbye.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The wait is over! The 105-day journey ends tonight as Vijay Sethupathi lights up the stage to crown the winner of this season.

videos.title: BBTam: Season Premiere
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns with a new season that’s bold, unpredictable, and packed with drama. Let the chaos begin!

videos.title: BBTam Day 1: Who Deserves to be A Leader?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes everyone with the ‘Night Stars’ task.The democracy rules are read and each one gets to pitch their leadership qualities. Who will emerge as the first leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 2: The Power Cards are Here!
videos.overview: As kitchen team does the luxury budget shopping, Avinash manages to win the Asura Pasi task. Amidst the arguments and chaos, BB announces some special power cards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 3: A Shocking Exit
videos.overview: Mukesh chooses Muniyamma and Chandini for the Style Patrol, while arguments erupt in the leader's meet. Avinash gets unlimited food, and a surprise exit leaves everyone emotional.

videos.title: BBTam Day 4: New Entry and Leadership Crisis
videos.overview: Kitchen fights end in a captaincy shift, Muniyamma breaks down in jail, and a new commoner enters. Tensions peak in the democracy question hour as leader Shatiga gets targeted.

videos.title: BBTam Day 5: The First Eviction Stuns All
videos.overview: Vinoth becomes leader and names three weakest performers. Eviction voting sends one out, while the Review Board puts Lakshmipriya in danger.

videos.title: BBTam Day 6: Vijay Sethupati Takes the Stage
videos.overview: VJS welcomes Manivannan and later discusses democracy with the housemates. He grills Shathiga on leadership and Vinoth Babu on opposition duties.

videos.title: BBTam Day 7: Eviction and New Rules
videos.overview: VJS questions the evictee and asks to describe the housemates. He checks on the contestants about the new power system, and then asks them to name two least deserving leaders.

videos.title: BBTam Day 8: Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: The new entry sparks tension. As Shama dominates the leadership task, democracy room drama triggers a walkout. Luxury shopping and nominations add more chaos.

videos.title: BBTam Day 9: Welcome to the Battleground
videos.overview: The kitchen becomes ground zero for fights when housemates clash over their duties and tea. The tasks add fuel to the fire as punishments are given and stories are stopped midway.

videos.title: BBTam Day 10: Eviction Free Pass Is Here!
videos.overview: Ansar’s ratings raise eyebrows, while kitchen drama brings Anandhi to tears. As physical tussles erupt in the cheese task for the pass, Shama changes the least deserving list.

videos.title: BBTam Day 11: Power Shifts and Food War
videos.overview: What begins with a food clash, ends in an assembly revolt. A dramatic resignation and high-stakes re-election follows. Who will become the new leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 12: New King and Servants
videos.overview: Task disputes bring debates over fair play among the contestants. Prithvi becomes king with three servants, an eviction looms, and two members head straight to jail.

videos.title: BBTam Day 13: VJS Exposes Housemates' Bias
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupati welcomes Anandhi and grills Shama over her leadership, task U-turns. He then calls out the ruling team in the Democracy Room for failing to support their own.

videos.title: BBTam Day 14: Who Will Join VJS Onstage
videos.overview: Anandi upsets VJS while he discusses the task issues. Leaderships are compared, and Mukesh saves one with the Eviction Free Pass. Who will finally bid goodbye today?

videos.title: BBTam Day 15: New Leader and Nominations!
videos.overview: Avinash is the new leader! As he sorts the teams, ruling vs opposition clash over the cleaning rules. Ansar and Shathiga's food spat precedes a tense nomination round.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: Titles and Transformations
videos.overview: Muniyammal’s comments raise eyebrows. Later, housemates impersonate each other in a fun content creator task before assigning sarcastic titles in a board game.

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: Avinash's Strategic Move
videos.overview: Clashes, tears and tough calls! Shama-Jason fight halts the task, but Avinash wins big. Asmitha struggles with Anandhi, while the exit board results leave Shathiga in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 18: Exit Board Triggers Tiffs
videos.overview: Muniyammal confronts Avinash over her exit board spot. Later in democracy proceedings Jason's question triggers chaos. Avinash reshuffles the board, getting into trouble again.

videos.title: BBTam Day 19: Angry Tears and Angry Exits
videos.overview: Lakshmi Priya gets evicted. However, before leaving, she has a lot to say to Avinash. Meanwhile, Bigg Boss calls the housemates to the confession room for a special selection.

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Eviction Twist Unveiled
videos.overview: Anandhi's eviction twist is revealed, and the shame segment targets Raghav. Avinash is praised as well as criticised by VJS, while Jason and Shama get a earful for their behaviour.

videos.title: BBTam Day 21: VJS Drops A Major Game Twist
videos.overview: VJS confronts about the passive gameplay and questions Avinash's board choices. Javeed, Lakshmi Priya and Saviniya return as VJS reveals a twist, sweeping everyone off their feet.

videos.title: BBTam Day 22: Hotel Task with New Rules
videos.overview: Open nominations shake up the house, but BB twists the game. The Hotel task is launched with three pairs of guests. As manager Shama takes charge, how will this battle proceed?

videos.title: BBTam Day 23: Task Wars and Ruthless Roast
videos.overview: Housemates fight over washrooms and fake tags. The rope creates clashes and hotel guests face harsh consequences for it. The debate and roast battle intensifies the situations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 24: The Big Cash Box Dilemma
videos.overview: Asmitha and Saviniya clash over sleep, leaving Saviniya in tears. BB drops a cash box offer, leaving Kumaran contemplating his choice before the house turns into a wild jungle.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Grand Opening, Grand Problem
videos.overview: BB Hotel opens with outrage as food delays anger guests. Manager Lakshmi Priya confronts Dhanya and Javeed over kitchen blunders, leaving Dhanya in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 26: BB Hotel Gets Reviewed
videos.overview: Fights, tears and tough reviews mark BB Hotel 2.0. Kumaran cuts the rope to save Lakshmipriya, while Saviniya–Asmitha and Danya–Javeed fail to agree on who stays.

videos.title: BBTam Day 27: VJS Reviews BB Hotel 2.0
videos.overview: VJS quizzes the housemates on the rope choices and the re-entered trio's promises. Shama's managerial stint draws mixed views, while Vijay probes on why BB Hotel 2.0 failed.

videos.title: BBTam Day 28: Wildcards Bring Instant Drama
videos.overview: VJS interacts with Kumaran before the danger-zone housemates award an eviction-free pass. Three wildcards enter with high stake tasks that stir immediate drama in the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 29: New Leader and Nominations
videos.overview: Karishma's questions stirs the house, before a leadership task for the wildcards. Following the nominations process, a bedroom inspection triggers a fight between Vasan and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 30: Chaos, Betrayals and Magic Potions
videos.overview: Avinash and Muniyammal clash disrupts the house. Amidst secret deals and betrayals, the high stakes magic potion task triggers fierce fights between Raghav and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 31: Blue Bricks Rule!
videos.overview: Raghav and Muthazhagi end in tears, while a block-grabbing fairness debate divides the house. As few get eliminated from the task, Jason's comment on Avinash triggers a fight.

videos.title: BBTam Day 32: Complaints and Clarifications
videos.overview: Foul play allegations erupt after Muthazhagi's block move. Democracy room brings apologies and tears, while teams clash for survival in the magic potion task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 33: Victory and Heartfelt Letters
videos.overview: The magic potion task crowns its winners with immunity, while evicted ones face punishments. Worst players are voted for, as anonymous letters bring tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 34: Praises and Warning
videos.overview: VJS appreciates previous week's performances and asks the housemates to review wildcard gameplay. He advises Jason on his remarks.
