videos.title: The Trance
videos.overview: Day 7: Goddess' Dance The families find solace in the memories of their kids. Kothandaraman investigates inside the burnt factory. Sakkarai and Regina fear the worst and she makes a hasty arrest. Through the enquiry, Sakkarai finds out the answer to the question previously posed by Nandini. He is disturbed. The DNA results from the autopsy test are out - Nandini can barely handle the news.

videos.title: Firewalker
videos.overview: Day 8: The Firewalking Ceremony The cops continue to systematically investigate the Nila-Adhisayam case. The doctor attending to Nandini suggest that she needs psychiatric help and Shanmugam shoots it down immediately. Kothandaraman works the case tirelessly. Sakkarai bends the rules in pursuing his suspect. Shanmugam and Regina, desperate to avenge the crime, take matters into their own hands.

videos.title: The Silence
videos.overview: Day 9: The Swing Kothandaraman now has all the details for the fire report. Nandini's psychiatrist identifies gaps in her memories. Mukesh Vadde is vexed on seeing how futile their plans have turned out to be. A lonely figure walks up to the edge of the cliff. The entire town is at the Mayana Kollai’s grand finale - The 'Oonjal.' The Goddess is done with Her work. Now, She rests.

videos.title: The Beginnings
videos.overview: Nandini is on trial for Guna's murder, defended by respected lawyer Chellappa, a father figure to Sakkarai. Chellappa invites Sakkarai to the Ashtakaali festival but is soon found dead in a locked cottage with a missing gun. Sakkarai becomes the investigating officer, creating tension with Inspector Moorthy. In the locked room murder, Sakkarai finds a hidden shocker!

videos.title: The Confluence
videos.overview: Amidst the festival chaos, Sakkarai grapples with the mute woman from the crime scene, desperate to uncover her identity. Nandini befriends a powerful inmate, while Malathy voices her mistrust of Inspector Moorthy. As Amman processions flood Kaalipattinam, young women from all walks of life emerge with fierce determination. Sakkarai receives a shocking call that blows the case wide open.

videos.title: ⁠The Outliers
videos.overview: A verbatim confession from the 7 young women who surrendered at different police stations, each claiming to have killed Chellappa sends Sakkarai's head spinning. He requests Nandini to be his eyes and ears in the sub-jail the women are lodged in. In lieu of the festival, a low-key funeral is held for the grand man, Chellappa. Dhamu steps up in a time of need, making an immense personal sacrifice.

videos.title: The Knot
videos.overview: Sakkarai diligently searches for connections among the eight women, and Nandini offers him a promising lead. Sakkarai uncovers Chellappa's fraught relationship with the local private school, revealing a potential motive for its owner, Prayamvata. Just when he thinks he has a handle on the case, Sakkarai receives devastating new information-Chellappa may not be the savior he once believed him to be

videos.title: The Conundrum
videos.overview: A stage play in the festival reinstates Sakkarai's resolve to find the young women justice. Sakkarai finds a pathbreaking lead at the crime site. With fresh forensic reports, he imagines the sequence of events on the fateful night. Dhamu's shocking confession solidifies Sakkarai's new image of Chellappa. The young women in the prison pull a risky stunt. Nandini and Sakkarai get the women to talk.

videos.title: The Guardians
videos.overview: 10 years ago: Ravi and Naagamma are a happy, loving couple from the fishing community. Naagamma's world turns topsy-turvy when she discovers Ravi's dark secrets. She takes an extreme measure to set things right. Risking her life, she takes up the role of a protector. Chellappa gets sucked into the vortex in an effort to help Naagamma's efforts to restore a broken path.

videos.title: The Unravel
videos.overview: Sakkarai learns that Chellappa has been trying to crack and nab the kingpin of the human trafficking ring for the past 10 years. Shared grief brings Sundar and Dhamu closer. A shocking development sends Sakkarai on a time sensitive chase. The 8 women finally reveal their story from the night of the murder. The elusive demon prepares for battle, putting the 8 women in grave danger.

videos.title: The Sublime
videos.overview: Sakkarai fixates on the case and nails Chellappa's killer. With the identity of their demon revealed, the 8 women gear up for revenge, but their demon puts up a formidable fight. Sakkarai goes on an epic chase to save the newly trafficked kids. Just as the festival goers wash away their past, Sakkarai, Nandhini and the 8 women are presented an opportunity to let go of their past and start anew

tamil-series.name: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal
tamil-series.description:
The story revolves around a group of high school students and the struggles the high school students from that group face during their secondary school life such as jealousy, rivalry, misunderstandings, arguments and personal grudges.

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar
📅 OTT Release: 2025-02-14

videos.title: S02 EP01
videos.overview: First episode - dreams

videos.title: The Result
videos.overview: While Siragugal school rejoices, Modern school's result takes a diverse turn. As Abi reminds Kalai of their bet, Gowtham meets Nandini, leaving her mother dubious and Swetha upset.

videos.title: Time To Celebrate
videos.overview: Malar and Guna share a moment. Bullet consoles an emotional Guna, and Nandini gets warned by her mother. Raju plans a trip as Gowtham and the gang decide to party.

videos.title: Family Comes First
videos.overview: Nandini makes a promise to her mother. Kalai, Abi, Stella and their friends go to Kulandhai's farm to celebrate. Gowtham and his squad meet an unexpected person. They have a blast.

videos.title: Failed Attempts
videos.overview: After several attempts, Gowtham and his gang finally hit the bottle and get clicked. Abi tries to make Kalai speak his mind but in vain. Guna and Bullet play a prank on Sagayam.

videos.title: New Entries
videos.overview: The gang's attempt to rag new students fails. A new teacher walks in as Guna and Malar worry about the staff's salary. Nachiyappan tries to learn about Siragugal's position.

videos.title: New Friends, New Enemies
videos.overview: New teacher Thilothama impresses her students. Praveen and Naveen try to sneak in weed. After Guna taunts Nachiyappan about Siragugal's success, he finds ways to malign the school.

videos.title: The Lab Accident
videos.overview: Guna's staff supports his request for some time to settle their salary. His happiness is short-lived when he learns about the lab catching fire. Poochi blames Mani for the incident.

videos.title: Roses on Thorns
videos.overview: Rekha, a mother who lives on thorns, wishes to give a life filled with flowers to her daughter, Maha. But fate has other plans when a man they trust betrays them.

videos.title: Gates of Hope
videos.overview: As Maha waits for Guna, he is thrilled when Malar shares good news with him. Sakthi overhears his mother talking to his father, an underrated cop, about his lost promotion.

videos.title: Best Enemies
videos.overview: Kasi beats up Rekha to reveal Maha's location. Sakthi is disappointed to see his father being mistreated by his rival Karthick and his dad.

videos.title: New Class, New Stories
videos.overview: It's the first day of school, and the students of Grade 11-A go through introductions, spats and emotional moments. Meanwhile, Guna introduces a new class teacher to them.

videos.title: Different Parenting
videos.overview: Kasi forces Rekha to accept Malar's call. Nikitha's parents scold her harshly for singing in front of everyone. Karthick insults Sakthi's father in school, enraging the latter.

videos.title: Rep Elections
videos.overview: Elections to choose the class representative become the hot topic in Siragugal. All is not well at home for Yamini and Madhi. Sakthi's father asks him about his first day.

videos.title: Haunted Hostel
videos.overview: Karthick asks his father for a motorbike with his mother's help. Sasi and Ekambaram settle in the boys' hostel and get unsettled. Danger approaches Maha after she falls asleep.

videos.title: Double Twin Flames
videos.overview: Yamini and Madhi talk about their choice for the rep election. Sasi and Ekambaram are introduced to the 'friendly' Santhosh Sir. Guna receives a strange parcel.

videos.title: Unexpected Candidates
videos.overview: Guna is disturbed by Nachiappan's threats. The rep election rules bring forth unlikely candidates. Kasi is still hunting for Maha, keeping Rekha captive.

videos.title: Physics vs Chemistry
videos.overview: A timetable mix-up leads to an argument between Class 11-A's chemistry and physics teachers. Karthi's mother blames Sakthi for her son's inability to contest the election.

videos.title: Family Promises
videos.overview: Kasi tries to find Maha's whereabouts through the other women. Ekambaram remembers his promise to his father when he sees Priya alighting from a fancy car.

videos.title: Sakthi or Maha?
videos.overview: The rep election results are out, and Sakthi and Maha get equal votes. Kasi's goons get a lead on Maha's location. Will they find her?

videos.title: Bullet Is Back
videos.overview: Guna feels elated as Bullet returns from his village. As Sakthi's friends celebrate his win, Karthick's attempt to talk to Maha fails. Will Bujji's prank on Sasikumar prove fatal?

videos.title: Reality Check
videos.overview: Karthick makes Sakthi's first day as the class rep difficult. Guna receives a notice regarding the school. Priya's dad reminds her about their life. Karthick's parents surprise him.

videos.title: Bitter Past
videos.overview: Sakthi shares the news about becoming the class rep with his father. Janani's painful past makes her bond with her friends stronger. Priya finds it hard to accept the reality.

videos.title: How to Save Siragugal?
videos.overview: Guna seeks legal help to save his school. Worried, Rekha informs Malar about Kasi's efforts to find Maha. The school committee agrees with Jeeva's idea regarding the road situation.

videos.title: Attack Mode
videos.overview: When Kasi's search for Maha fails in Chennai, he reaches Kanchipuram. Guna and Madan get into a tiff with Kasi's goons while Karthik vents his fury by hurting Sakthi with his bike.

videos.title: Consequences
videos.overview: Karthick's father punishes Sakthi's dad for the rift between the boys. Sakthi's dad reports a gang making illicit liquor. Maha gets upset as her friends enjoy her mom's dance on TV.

videos.title: The Spotlight
videos.overview: Madan organises a street play to create awareness about the school's issue. While Maha refuses to act, Nikitha breaks down when her dad warns her not to participate in the play.

videos.title: Impactful Street Play
videos.overview: Karthick enters the boy's hostel with Bujji. The students deliver an amazing street play and create awareness about their school's situation. But what happens when Kasi spots Maha?

videos.title: Narrow Escape
videos.overview: Maha smartly evades Kasi in the crowd. Nachiappan mocks Guna about the street play. Karthick's friends refuse to believe him that Maha was holding his hand during the street play.

videos.title: Hunger Strike
videos.overview: Guna's decision to conduct a hunger strike as his next move to save Siragugal School is accepted by the staff. A pregnant Malar too joins the strike along with the students.

videos.title: The Boys are Back
videos.overview: The ex-students from Siragugal extend their support by joining the strike. Everyone is shocked when Karthick's father gets his police force to clear the crowd at Siragugal.

videos.title: The Sacrifices
videos.overview: To everyone's surprise, Karthick's father lends his support to the cause. Dinakaran handles the pressure from his higher officials. Meanwhile, Sagayam's health deteriorates.

videos.title: Court Order
videos.overview: A court's stay order brings relief to Guna and the students. Rekha spots Maha on a news channel, and worries about Kasi seeing it. Meanwhile who saved the school at the last minute?

videos.title: Conceited Attitude
videos.overview: Guna honours Inspector Dinakaran for extending his support to the school. Sakthi feels his father Palani's efforts are neglected. A proud Karthick gets into a dispute with Ranjith.

videos.title: Bold Class Rep
videos.overview: Karthick tries to impress Maha with home food. Jeeva's sad past does not stop him from spreading fun in his class. Sakthi stands up for his friends when Santhosh Sir thrashes them.

videos.title: Eavesdropping
videos.overview: Sakthi's bold move earns everyone two days to study. Bujji overhears Guna telling the staff about Siragugal School drafting the quarterly exam question papers for the entire district.

videos.title: Bujji's Efforts
videos.overview: Sakthi agrees to teach physics to Madhi and Yamini. Bujji's father warns him and gives him the last chance to pass his exams. Perturbed, Bujji seeks his uncle's help.

videos.title: Insulted Father
videos.overview: Karthick gets punished by Dinakaran when his senior insults him for giving him a bike. He is warned to score better marks than Sakthi. Nikitha gets angry as her parents push her to study.

videos.title: The Question Paper
videos.overview: Madhi and Yamini feel excited to learn from Sakthi. Bujji discreetly shares the question paper with Karthick, John, Ekambaram and Sasi. Doubting Bujji, Mahesh and Ranjith question him.

videos.title: Exam Preparations
videos.overview: Santhosh Sir punishes a student for his rude behaviour. Dinakaran gifts a pen to Karthick, who resolves not to cheat in the exams. Nikitha gets upset as her dad argues with a neighbour.

videos.title: Exam Day
videos.overview: While Bujji's friends thank him for the question paper, Karthick does not tell them that he did not cheat in the exams. Later, he reminds Sakthi about his challenge.

videos.title: Manipulated Scores
videos.overview: Guna gets a call from the police station regarding his students. Santhosh Sir's letter to Bujji surprises everyone. Guna challenges Nachiappan when he tries to defame his students.

videos.title: Cheaters Always Losers
videos.overview: Amazed by their good scores, the class starts to rejoice. But Malar breaks the news about a gang cheating in the exams. Bujji and his pals get pulled up for their misdeed.

videos.title: Suppressed Truth
videos.overview: Karthick feels dejected as his truth gets stifled. The parents of students who cheated are asked to attend the PTA in school. Sakthi informs his father of what transpired in school.

videos.title: The Parents' Meeting
videos.overview: It is the day of the dreaded meeting. With a heavy heart, Guna informs the parents about what happened. Karthick tries to convince Guna once again that he didn't cheat.

videos.title: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
videos.overview: Bujji's father beats him for cheating in the exams. Heartbroken to hear about his son, Dinakaran thrashes Karthick in front of everyone. Karthick breaks down as no one believes him.

videos.title: Silenced by Punishment
videos.overview: Bujji and Ekambaram's fathers get into a fight. Guna plans to hold a cultural event. When Dinakaran punishes Karthick, Bujji, Ekambaram and Sasi welcome him to their hostel.

videos.title: Humiliation and Shame
videos.overview: Maha feels sad for Karthick. While Madan Sir shows his anger through his actions, Karthick maintains that he is innocent. Shakthi is selected as the secretary of the cultural event.

videos.title: The Ignored Gang
videos.overview: Bujji and his friends plan to partake in the cultural event, but Guna and Malar refuse them. Nikitha gets upset as her father warns her not to participate in the singing competition.

videos.title: The Cultural Event
videos.overview: Sakthi and his friends begin their practice sessions. Madhi gets angry as Yamini also brings food for Sakthi. The students feel excited as Agni Siragugal 2024 is inaugurated.

videos.title: Impromptu Speech
videos.overview: Guna gives an impactful inaugural speech. Nachiappan mocks Guna that his school will not win the cup. Sakthi is declared winner for his impromptu speech in the elocution competition.

videos.title: Intellectual Theft
videos.overview: Janani's moving poetry bags her the medal. Maha conveys her story beautifully in her drawing and wins first place. Desperate, Modern School students steal Sakthi and team's concept.

videos.title: Authoritative Parenting
videos.overview: Guna arranges lodging for all the participants in the school hostel. Maha dedicates her medal to Karthick. Malar calls Nikitha's father as he stops her from partaking in the contest.

videos.title: Caged Bird
videos.overview: Karthick gets mocked for writing a drama script. Nikitha's friends save her when her dad locks her at home. She is declared the winner for her performance, but is it worth the risk?

videos.title: Failed Efforts
videos.overview: Sakthi and his team are shocked as their script gets stolen. Maha suggests Karthick's script, but Guna rejects it and announces that Siragugal will not partake in the drama contest.

videos.title: Never Give Up
videos.overview: After Maha convinces everyone to accept Karthick's script, he guides the team, and they give a brilliant performance. Sakthi's act touches every heart, including Karthick's.

videos.title: Overall Trophy
videos.overview: Though upset with Malar for defying him, Guna acknowledges the student's victory. Karthick feels hurt as Guna ignores his efforts. Kasi and Rekha get to perform in Kanchipuram.

videos.title: Shattered Reality
videos.overview: Kasi grows wary when Rekha accepts the show. Nikitha lashes out at her parents for being unsupportive. Maha feels dejected about not being able to share her victory with her mother.

videos.title: Still Not Friends
videos.overview: Dinakaran feels touched to see his son's photo in the papers. Karthick thanks Maha for trusting him, unlike his friends. Sakthi intercedes when Mahesh and Ranjith fight with Karthick.

videos.title: Misunderstood By Friends
videos.overview: Karthick gets mocked for his friendship with Maha. Nikitha shares her grief with her pals while Guna warns Karthick as he beats John for wrongly accusing him.

videos.title: Lonesome
videos.overview: Karthick's father berates him when he returns home after the hostel incident. Maha scolds John and his team for not supporting Karthick. Madhi and Yamini get lunch for Sakthi.

videos.title: Trouble Child
videos.overview: Karthick's friends tease him, but when they get into trouble, he saves them, earning his father's ire. Sakthi informs Bujji and the others about Karthick's plight at the police station.

videos.title: Bonding With Friends
videos.overview: Maha learns of her mom's visit to Kanchipuram. Karthick's friends apologise to him for their mistakes, but Dinakaran is called to the school for his misconduct. Kasi suspects Rekha.

videos.title: Risky Wish
videos.overview: When Maha desperately tries to meet her mother, Janani calls Karthick for help. Bujji and his friends create commotion and help Maha leave the hostel with Karthick on his bike.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: With their friends' help, Maha and Karthick arrive at the temple festival to meet Rekha. The next challenge they face is hoodwinking Kasi and his goons.

videos.title: Unexpected Opportunity
videos.overview: Curious about Karthick and Maha, Palani talks to Sakthi. Sasi's dad invites him and his friends to a village festival. Singer Srilekha calls Malar and asks about Nikitha.

videos.title: Supportive Friends
videos.overview: Malar talks to Nikitha about the competition, only to get a surprising response. Karthick asks Maha about her secret meeting with her mom. Sasi invites the teachers to his village.

videos.title: The Invite
videos.overview: Nikitha's friends coax her to join the talent show. Sasi invites the whole class, except Sakthi and his gang. When Guna and Malar are invited, he has a condition.

videos.title: Parent's Consent
videos.overview: The students are elated when their parents sign the no-objection letter and permit them to go to Sasi's hometown. Surprisingly, Nikitha's parents also allow her to join the trip.

videos.title: Boarding Time
videos.overview: Sasi hands over the no-objection letters to Jeeva Sir. Everyone assembles at the bus stop to leave for Madurai. Mahdi and Yamini reserve a seat each for Sakthi. Who will he sit with?

videos.title: The Journey
videos.overview: The journey to Madurai begins. Bujji gets into trouble with the driver. The students enjoy and play fun games. Madhi feels disappointed when Sakthi sits with Yamini.

videos.title: Sasi's Girl
videos.overview: The students receive a warm welcome at Sasi's house. Sasi introduces Pooja to his grandmother and his dad narrates the family history. The girls impress all with their ethnic wear.

videos.title: Disappointing Menu
videos.overview: While everyone eagerly waits for the non-veg feast, Sasi's father has news for them. The kids play Truth or Dare with some surprising results.

videos.title: No Religious Barriers
videos.overview: Sasi gives everyone a taste of how the day starts in the village. Tension rises when John's presence in the temple is questioned by the priest. Pooja meets the sacrificial goat.

videos.title: Movie Time
videos.overview: Because of Pooja, Sasi feels conflicted about the sacrificial ceremony. He organises a village-style movie screening, which becomes a different experience for everyone.

videos.title: The Missing Goat
videos.overview: When Sasi tries to console Pooja, she tells him that if he saves the sacrificial goat, he will be her favourite person. What he does next causes utter chaos.

videos.title: Supernatural Search
videos.overview: Pooja corners Sasi and forces him to reveal the truth. Although Sasi's father goes to the police to find the goat, the villagers persuade him to seek help from a higher power.

videos.title: Loving Granny
videos.overview: When Sasi's uncle announces a significant reward for finding the goat, Sasi gets furious but his friends are elated. Distressed by the missing goat, his grandmother falls sick.

videos.title: Granny's Unexpected Decision
videos.overview: Pooja drowns in guilt and reveals the truth to her friends. Sasi's grandmother's health worsens, making his father order the sacrifice of 100 goats.

videos.title: Sasi's Ear Piercing
videos.overview: Sasi's dad has another event planned, much to the boy's distress. As the trip comes to a close, Nikitha gets a call from the talent show.

videos.title: Surprise Trip
videos.overview: Sasi's mother gets emotional as the students leave for Chennai. His grandmother blesses each one of them. Seeing everyone sad, Sasi surprises them with a trekking trip.

videos.title: Thug Life
videos.overview: Sakthi tends to Madhi and Yamini's wounds as everyone treks to the top of the hill. After reaching the camping spot, unexpected visitors try to create trouble for the students.

videos.title: Eerie Stories
videos.overview: Settling the girls in the tents, the boys go fishing and return with a good catch. After dinner, Mahesh, Madhi, and Ekambaram fuel the eerie atmosphere with horror stories.

videos.title: Arson
videos.overview: The drunk men seek revenge for the insult by setting the tents on fire and putting everyone's lives at risk. The rescue team arrives to save the team, but Nikita's condition worsens.

videos.title: Shattered Parents
videos.overview: Sakthi consoles Nikita's parents as her condition leaves them shattered. Later, Nikitha is declared out of danger, but Sasi feels guilty for putting everyone's life at risk.

videos.title: Master Returns
videos.overview: The teachers get furious. Malar takes the students to task during assembly. When they blame Sasi for the mishap, Sakthi stands by him. They panic when Santhosh sir returns to school.

videos.title: New Feelings
videos.overview: Nikitha has an emotional moment with her parents. The teachers refuse to pardon the students. Sakthi shares his feelings for Nikitha with Mahesh. He feels happy to spend time with her.

videos.title: Gang Reputation
videos.overview: Sasi and his friends are humiliated in the hostel. Nikitha receives a warm welcome in school. Karthick and the team persuade Nikitha to take up Singer Sriram's singing show offer.

videos.title: Acceptance
videos.overview: Nikitha's friends convince her parents to let her sing in the competition. Her parents accompany her for the audition in Chennai. Yamini learns about Madhi's feelings for Sakthi.

videos.title: Broken Bond
videos.overview: Nikita clears the audition, but Malar puts forth a condition. Sakthi scolds Madhi and Yamini for forcing him to eat. The students realise how much trouble they have caused the school.

videos.title: Growing Distance
videos.overview: The students get scolded in the Tamil class. Sakthi brings a gift for Nikita. Madhi and Yamini's mothers worry about their rift. The Super Singer team arrives to shoot Nikitha.

videos.title: Is It Love?
videos.overview: Malar gives permission to shoot in the school premises. Nikitha's friends rejoice when her show is aired on TV. While Sakthi phones Nikita to wish her, Madhi is unable to reach him.

videos.title: Budding Director
videos.overview: Madhi takes care of an ailing Yamini. Hesitant at first, Maha agrees to act in the Karthick-directed short film for a state-level competition. Malar allows him to shoot in the school.

videos.title: Madhi's Proposal
videos.overview: Sakthi waits with Nikitha as she practices. Sakthi's reply stuns Madhi after Priya urges her to voice her feelings to him. Karthick completes his short film with the help of his friends.

videos.title: The Super Singer
videos.overview: Nikitha's parents are elated after her performance in the Super Singer show. Yamini feels hurt to know that Sakthi loves someone else. Maha admires Karthick after watching his film.

videos.title: A Short Film by Karthick
videos.overview: Karthick's film is nominated for the film festival award. Malar is stunned after watching it. Nikitha's friends celebrate her win. Nachiappan challenges Malar to a science exhibition.

videos.title: The Abduction
videos.overview: Karthick's film garners attention all over. When it reaches Kasi's gang, Maha gets kidnapped from the school premises. Everyone suggests Karthick get his father's help to find her.

videos.title: Helpless Maha
videos.overview: Guna and Malar inform Dinakaran about Maha's situation. He gets furious to learn that Karthick is in love with Maha, who is the daughter of a dancer. Unfortunately, Maha reaches Kasi.

videos.title: Locked Up
videos.overview: Maha is in trouble in Kasi's custody. Dinakaran locks Karthick in the house, but he escapes. When Sakthi learns shocking news from his father, he and Karthick decide to look for Maha.

videos.title: Smart Thinking
videos.overview: Karthick and Sakthi call Kasi for Maha's whereabouts. Sakthi's father decides to help in their search. Karthick's smart idea helps find the location of the goons. Will they find Maha?

videos.title: Brave Souls
videos.overview: Kasi and his gang get arrested after Sakthi and Karthick rescue Maha with Palani's aid. Karthick chooses to return to the hostel and his son's hatred for him leaves Dinakaran shattered.

videos.title: Reap What You Sow
videos.overview: Guna praises Sakthi and Karthick in the school assembly. Palani is promoted to inspector, while Dinakaran gets transferred. The class is shocked to see Karthick and Sakthi's bond.

videos.title: Science Projects
videos.overview: Guna agrees to the student's request to attend a science exhibition at the Modern School. Madhi's mother reminds her daughter and Yamini of the value of their friendship.

videos.title: Best Friends Forever
videos.overview: Yamini and Madhi realise their mistake and get back together. However, Sakthi's answer about the love of his life shocks them. Nachiappan insults Siragugal students at the exhibition.

videos.title: The Innocent Suspect
videos.overview: Dharshini, a Modern School student, slaps Sakthi when he mistakenly runs into her. Later, she jumps from the terrace. Palani is shocked when Sakthi is arrested for her death.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Guna fumes as the school's name gets tarnished. Dinakaran is appointed as the investigative officer in Sakthi's case. Sakthi's friends learn a shocking truth about the Modern School.

videos.title: A Bold Move
videos.overview: The girls share the truth about Dharshini's death with Karthick. While Palani assures his wife, the girls make a plan to save Sakthi and execute the first step to catch the culprit.

videos.title: The Confession
videos.overview: The incident becomes a hot topic in the news. The police are pressurised to take action. The girls manage to get a confession from the Modern School students against their teacher.

videos.title: Truth Alone Triumphs
videos.overview: Nachiappan spurns his students' complaints against the teacher. Nikitha motivates them to go to the cops, who promptly take action.

videos.title: Friendship is the Real Treasure
videos.overview: Palani apologises to Sakthi for his helplessness. Sakthi's friends give him a warm welcome in school. Guna, Malar and Jeeva talk to their students.

tamil-series.name: Ninaithen Vandhai
tamil-series.description:
Ezhil is devastated after his wife Indhumathi’s death. A simple village girl, Sudarvizhi, steps in to be his children's caretaker. But can Sudarvizhi fill the void in Ezhil and his children’s hearts?

📺 Streaming on: Zee5
📅 OTT Release: 2025-01-19

videos.title: Ezhil Saves Nirmala
videos.overview: Ezhil’s kids get scolded by teachers for being mischievous. Ezhil operates on Nirmala after seeing her husband plead with the doctors. Later, the kids think of their late mother, Indhumathi.

videos.title: Abhi Disobeys Sudarvizhi
videos.overview: Sudarvizhi tells Abhi to get ready for school but she disobeys. Ezhil scolds Sudarvizhi for bringing lunch and refuses to eat. Kankavalli fixes the date for Sudarvizhi and Ezhil’s nuptial night.

tamil-series.name: Uppu Puli Kaaram
tamil-series.description:
A hotel owner and father of four faces a predicament with the arrival of his abandoned son. Will the family dynamics get spicier or sour?

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar
📅 OTT Release: 2025-01-02

videos.title: Meet the UPK Family
videos.overview: Meet the lovely family of Subramani and Subbu. As they try to convince Chinmayi to wed, her siblings eavesdrop on them. Shiva is surprised to run into his past love, Chinmayi.

videos.title: Matchmaking
videos.overview: Shiva is elated that Chinmayi is unmarried, but she is irked when he questions her. As her parents struggle to stall a matchmaking, the groom is shocked by Chinmayi's confession.

videos.title: Hurdles and Hope
videos.overview: Thippu is angry as he becomes a meme material for his acting performance. Subramani gets a notice to vacate the hotel premises. Shiva is excited to learn about the college reunion.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Subbu argues with Sharmila only to realise that she is the new owner. Shiva is irked as Chinmayi evades him. All hell breaks loose as the siblings turn the house into a war ground.

videos.title: Conundrum
videos.overview: Yashika finally clears an interview but lands in a fix as she meets Sushi, her college senior. Thippu is elated to get a chance to star in a web series but it is a father-son story.

videos.title: Resolutions
videos.overview: Chinmayi convinces Yashika to take up the job. Thippu feels humiliated as the director rejects him for his soulless acting. He decides to find out about his father.

videos.title: Celebration and Chaos
videos.overview: As the family celebrates Yashika's new job, Thippu learns his father's name. The mornings become more chaotic as the three sisters struggle to get ready on time.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Things get personal as Chinmayi and Shiva take centre stage in a debate show. While Yashika is excited on her first day of work, she gets into an embarrassing situation with Thippu.

videos.title: Frustrated Souls
videos.overview: While Shiva gets warned by his boss, Chinmayi becomes drunk after losing a case for the first time in her career. Things take an unexpected turn when the frustrated duo meet again.

videos.title: Restless Curiosity
videos.overview: Chinmayi gets disturbed after learning about what transpired the previous night. As Subramani and Subbu visit their friend, Keerthy gets curious about Uday's antics.

videos.title: Unveiling Secrets
videos.overview: Keerthy decides to catch Uday red-handed, while Yashika learns that Thippu is a celebrity. Shiva and Chinmayi get excited about participating in a game show.

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: While Uday secretly visits the house in disguise, Shiva tricks Chinmayi into going out on a dinner date with him. Things go out of control when Subbu and Sharmila come face to face.

videos.title: Emotional Transformations
videos.overview: Impressed with Udhay's cooking, Sushi desires to marry him. Chinmayi gets rebuked by Subbu, while Thippu recreates a scene with enthusiasm after learning about his father.

videos.title: Ambitions Revealed
videos.overview: Keerthi doubts Udhay and checks his wallet to find a shopping bill. Chinmay is happy for Yashika. Udhay tells Chinmayi about his wish to open a restaurant instead of studying.

videos.title: Family Dynamics
videos.overview: Keerthi doubts Udhay and checks his wallet to find a shopping bill. Chinmay is happy for Yashika. Udhay tells Chinmayi about his wish to quit studying and open a multi-cuisine eatery.

videos.title: Critical Acts
videos.overview: Sharmila rescues Sharmila in time as the name board of her new coffee shop collapses. While the sisters bully Udhay, Shiva threatens to wed someone else if Chinmayi rejects him.

videos.title: Parental Longing
videos.overview: Sharmila expresses her feelings to her son, Shiva and tells him how much she misses him. One of Chinmayi's seniors asks her to meet his friend's son.

videos.title: Guidance and Care
videos.overview: Thippu teaches dialogue delivery to an unwilling Yashika. Chinmayi feels anxious as Shiva has neither called nor responded to her text messages.

videos.title: Crucial Messages
videos.overview: Chinmayi tells Anirudh to inform Shiva that she is going to meet a prospective groom. Subbu and her mother explore commercial properties for a shop.

videos.title: Curious Provocations
videos.overview: Keerthi takes a picture of Mahi to analyse why girls are drooling over him. Chinmayi meets her prospective groom and sends a selfie with him to Shiva.

videos.title: Unvoiced Desires
videos.overview: Thippu visits Subramani's hotel and yearns to call him father. A jealous Chinmayi rushes to Shiva's house at night to check on him.

videos.title: Shaming Revelations
videos.overview: Sushi ridicules Yashika and informs her colleagues about her being overweight in college. Keerthi is astonished to receive an invite to her ex-boyfriend's wedding.

videos.title: Meeting Mayhem
videos.overview: Chinmay bashes the matchmaker for bringing proposals for her. Yashika loses her calm and unleashes her karate skills when Sushi tries to oust her from the office meeting.

videos.title: Shocking Disclosure
videos.overview: Thippu feels terrible when he is replaced in a project based on a father-son relationship. Subramani's past comes back to haunt him when he meets a drunk Thippu.

videos.title: Mysterious Aroma
videos.overview: Gowtham helps Chinmayi defuse the attempts of the marriage broker. While Sharmila smells a lady's perfume on Shiva, Subbu tries to get Thippu's details.

videos.title: Unseen Omen
videos.overview: Sushi calls Udhay to meet for dinner, but he refuses. Sharmila's order shocks Subbu while Sheela questions Shiva about Chinmay. A dizzy spell leads to a startling revelation for Sushi.

videos.title: The Tangled Consequence
videos.overview: Thippu insists on firing Yashika from the job when he falls and gets hurt as she accidentally pulls a wire entangled in his chair. Keerthi encounters the unexpected at the gym.

videos.title: Heartfelt Commitment
videos.overview: Sharmila feels touched after reading Chandrashekar's poem. While Yashika tries to apologise to Thippu, Subramani vows to take care of him as his son. The doctor confirms Sushi's doubt.

videos.title: Hidden Pursuits
videos.overview: Subramani's search for Thippu's number leads him to Yashika's office, and he hides to avoid being noticed. Sharmila turns suspicious after finding a hairband in Shiva's room.

videos.title: Ultimatum and Disclosure
videos.overview: Keerthi demands Mahi's presence at a wedding, or she warns about divulging his secret. Sushi's revelation turns Udhay's life into a nightmare.

videos.title: Deceptive Disarray
videos.overview: Chinmayi delights everyone with breakfast and announces her plans to relocate closer to work for convenience. Udhay's lies regarding riches and the restaurant come to the fore.

videos.title: Intriguing Mysteries
videos.overview: Keerthi is intrigued by Mahi's rich appearance in a photo and doubts his true identity. The chaos intensifies when Sushi discovers Udhay's lies.

videos.title: Verdicts and Visions
videos.overview: As the family debates Chinmayi moving out, Subramani's decision disappoints her. Mahi's contrived closeness makes Keerthi wish their act is real.

videos.title: Verbal Duel
videos.overview: Sushi visits Annam Mess and learns of Udhay's lies. Much against his wish, Shiva is forced to collaborate with Thippu on a fictional show. An anxious Subramani visits Thippu.

videos.title: Tense Transition
videos.overview: Ramya is shocked to learn about Udhay's pregnant girlfriend from Kalyan. Chinmayi panics when her parents decide to accompany her to her new house. Sushi feels unwell in the office.

videos.title: Authentic Assurance
videos.overview: Thippu gets angry when Yashika asks him about his father. Elated, Keerthi questions Mahi about his feelings. A worried Subramani takes food for Thippu. Sushi faints on the road.

videos.title: Boundaries and Celebrations
videos.overview: Chinmayi sets ground rules for living with Shiva. Udhay returns home after his exam to a delightful surprise from his loving family.

videos.title: Dawn Discord
videos.overview: Chaos ensues when Sushi walks into Annam Mess and introduces herself to Subramani. Chinmay, Keerthi and Yashika resolve not to let Sushi trouble the family.

videos.title: Tactical Insight
videos.overview: Yashika advises Thippu, using a sports analogy, leading him to make a significant decision. Keerthi changes her voice to feign illness and skip work.

videos.title: Ring Ruckus
videos.overview: Sharmila appoints Subbu to help with her new coffee shop. Trouble ensues when Sharmila loses her diamond ring.

videos.title: Prejudice and Fixation
videos.overview: Sharmila accuses Subbu when her ring gets lost. The sisters are eager to know about Udhay's girlfriend, while Thippu feels anxious over a phone call.

videos.title: Memories and Murmurs
videos.overview: Chinmayi tries to deal with her bittersweet memories. Meanwhile, is Thippu head over heels in love?

videos.title: Mixed Emotions
videos.overview: Yashika is happy yet confused over Thippu's situation. Shiva's impatience boggles his decisions. The tables turn for Sushi, leaving her in shock.

videos.title: Confrontations Over Dinner
videos.overview: Yashika and Sushi feel awkward at the dinner table. Thippu's bond with Subramani moulds his acting. Sushi's efforts towards atonement fail to mend her deeds.

videos.title: Remedies and Regret
videos.overview: Shiva visits his mom with a request. Thippu's acting skills are put to the test for his new show. How will he perform?

videos.title: Longing of Unloved Souls
videos.overview: Thippu asks Subramani an important question and waits anxiously for his reply. Keerthi's boss suspects someone is squatting in the gym and decides to investigate, alarming her.

videos.title: Uneasy Love
videos.overview: A discussion at breakfast with Chinmayi gives Shiva a new perspective on this career. Ramya gets suspicious about Subramani's whereabouts and tells Subbu.

videos.title: Ruined Dreams
videos.overview: Subramani's visit to Thippu's house creates tension, leading to a confrontation with Subbu. Keerthi's dreams get shattered when Mahi receives a ring.

videos.title: Reconciliations
videos.overview: Mani tries to convince Subbu to allow him his fatherly duties. Thippu's oversharing makes him feel awkward around Yashika. Sushi worries about her secrets being exposed.

videos.title: Conditional/Unconditional
videos.overview: Mahi thanks his brother for the timely help. While Shiva and Chinmayi get ready to make dinner, Sharmila suddenly visits her son's house to give him an ultimatum.

videos.title: Tangled Conflicts
videos.overview: The family worries about Mani's ulcer. Shiva's mornings are not the same with Chinmayi around. Thippu gets provoked during a photoshoot.

videos.title: Dazed and Confused
videos.overview: Kalyan's advice dampens Udhay's excitement over the wedding. The kids become confused by Subbu's unusual message.

videos.title: House-quake
videos.overview: Thippu's moving in takes everyone off guard. Frustrated, the four siblings express their objections to the decision.

videos.title: Lost in Rumination
videos.overview: Subbu conveys Thippu's existence to her mother, Kalyan and Ramya. The siblings worry about living with their half-brother.

videos.title: Arrivals in Waiting
videos.overview: Udhay fusses over Sushi after visiting the doctor. Sharmila surprises Shiva with a blind date. Disappointed with her dad, Keerthi drowns her sorrows in alcohol at the gym.

videos.title: Rising Dilemma
videos.overview: Thippu breaks the news of his new living situation to Yashika. Armed with his lucky charm, he gets ready to move houses.

videos.title: Trying to Fit In
videos.overview: Despite Subramani's assurances, Thippu gets a lukewarm welcome. Yashika grows increasingly anxious when she is faced with the new reality.

videos.title: Cloud Burst
videos.overview: Chinmayi reveals the Thippu situation to Shiva, who finally connects the dots. Yashika calls out Sushi in front of Udhay, angering the former bully.

videos.title: Flat-Footed
videos.overview: Sushi and Udhay go house hunting but become disappointed, till Udhay offers a solution. Shiva calls out Sheela's name in his sleep, angering Chinmayi. A shock awaits Subbu at home.

videos.title: Running in Circles
videos.overview: Mahi sees a new side to Keerthi. Chinmayi comes across an unpleasant voice recording. Yashika strongly opposes Udhay's solution to his house problem and gets Thippu's support.

videos.title: Unspoken Strains
videos.overview: Udhay prepares breakfast and eagerly awaits Thippu's praise for his food. Chinmayi meets Yashika and subtly probes what's troubling her about Sushi.

videos.title: Fractured Bonds
videos.overview: Sushi reveals the reason behind her bullying of Yashika. Shiva asks Chinmayi's opinion on marriage, but she hopes he'll directly propose instead.

videos.title: Annoyed Reaction
videos.overview: Kalyan spills paint at work and gets harshly scolded by his boss, which Ramya sees. Mahi gets irritated by Keerthi's touch and sternly warns her to keep her distance.

videos.title: Heightened Tensions
videos.overview: Sushi's emotional outburst stirs Yashika. Keerthi spots Chinmayi and Shiva together at a convenience store. What follows next sends Chinmayi into a tizzy.

videos.title: Tote for Truths
videos.overview: Chinmayi resolves the issue with Keerthi by buying her a branded bag. Shiva feels elated to learn that Chinmayi is interested in marrying him.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: Thippu requests George to take Yashika off her role as his manager. Subramani delves into his past and uncovers a devastating tragedy from his childhood.

videos.title: Solitary Whispers
videos.overview: Subramani gives Udhay money for a wedding dress and advises him to be responsible. Subbu takes the girls shopping. Udhay's words make Thippu feel isolated within the family.

videos.title: Forbidden Entanglements
videos.overview: Keerthi reveals about Chinmayi to Yashika and Udhay. What happens when Subbu learns about Chinmayi's live-in relationship?

videos.title: Shattered Loyalties
videos.overview: Subbu is dumbfounded when she spots Chinmayi with Shiva. Sharmila cannot believe her ears when she learns that her son is in love with Chinmayi. What will the lovers do?

videos.title: Fatherly Sentiments
videos.overview: During an interview, Thippu becomes emotional when asked about his bond with his father. Keerthi learns the truth about Mahi and Raj.

videos.title: Healing Distance
videos.overview: Shiva's dad advises and asks him to seek Sharmila's forgiveness, but she sets conditions. Chinmayi and Shiva decide to stay away till the problem is resolved.

videos.title: Fury Unleashed
videos.overview: A furious Sharmila lashes out at Subramani and decides to sell the entire property. Yashika is impressed with Thippu's progress. Shiva arrives at Chinmayi's home to meet her family.

videos.title: Heartfelt Crossroads
videos.overview: Chinmayi feels torn between her furious parents and Shiva's request to wed. Thippu pacifies an irate Subbu by bringing her favourite Burmese food with Yashika. Why is Udhay angry?

videos.title: Guilt Trip
videos.overview: Sharmila's condition leaves Shiva feeling frustrated. Sushi's shocking revelation about her parents astounds Udhay. Besieged by guilt, Keerthi prepares to encounter Mahi at the gym.

videos.title: Performance Plummet
videos.overview: Subbu asks Thippu to shift to Udhay's 'cramped' room. Thippu's web series gets launched. However, the director is not pleased with his lacklustre performance.

videos.title: Mentorship and Awakening
videos.overview: Subramani advises Thippu on how to hone his acting abilities. Chinmayi and Sharmila have a heated argument. Shiva discovers a startling revelation about Chinmayi and his mother.

videos.title: Sorrowful Solace
videos.overview: Subramani overhears as Chinmayi shares her sorrow with Yashika and Keerthi. Angry with his mother, Shiva leaves his house. Yashika and Udhay help Thippu move into a new room.

videos.title: Heartfelt Confrontation
videos.overview: Udhay confides about his fear to his father. Shiva admonishes Sheela for talking ill about Chinmayi. Will Mahi confess his love to Keerthi?

videos.title: Candid Exchanges
videos.overview: A dejected Shiva informs his father of his resolution to end his relationship with Chinmayi. Sharmila is adamant about her decision. Thippu expresses his feelings to Subramani.

videos.title: Essential Modifications
videos.overview: Subramani requests Udhay to revise the catering plan in light of the budget constraints. Depressed, Shiva packs his things to move abroad.

videos.title: Sorrowful Hearts
videos.overview: Subbu reflects on the sorrowful past of Kasinathan and his mother, pondering how they endured such hardships and how the hospital nurse helped them. How was the kind nurse?

videos.title: Troubled Turns
videos.overview: Thippu accidentally loses Keerthi's handbag. Kalyan worries about his job. For his action practice scenes, Thippu gets stunt masters. But what happens to put him in a tough spot?

videos.title: Support and Departure
videos.overview: Keerthi helps Thippu to relieve his body pain. Kalyan puts Subbu in a tough spot. While Shiva returns Chinmayi’s belongings, she learns that he has vacated the house.

videos.title: Gifted Frustrations
videos.overview: Keerthi gets furious as Udhay gives her handbag to Suchi. Thippu treats a depressed Chinmay to dinner. Later, Chinmay is shocked to see Sharmila at her doorstep. What is her motive?

videos.title: Radiant Makeover
videos.overview: Sharmila pleads with Chinmayi to help her search for her son, Shiva. A fabulous makeover of Keerthi, Chinmayi and Yashika for Udhay and Sushi's marriage leaves everyone in awe.

videos.title: Embracing Truths
videos.overview: At Udhay and Sushi's wedding reception, Grandma's disclosure leaves the family shocked. Chinmayi heads to her friend's house, looking for a clue to locate Shiva. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Jealousy Unveiled
videos.overview: Seeing Yashika with Sunil, a jealous Thippu berates her. A reluctant Mahi admits his feelings to Keerthi. Sushi gets irked as she is removed from a vital project due to her pregnancy.

videos.title: Condition and Preparations
videos.overview: Chinmayi imposes conditions on Shiva for their marriage. Subramani prepares food and sends Udhay to deliver it to Thippu's shooting location. How will Sushi react?

videos.title: Balanced Discretion
videos.overview: Subbu tells Subramani to treat Thippu and Udhay equally. Keerthi wants Mahi to keep their relationship a secret. Sushi fusses over food.

videos.title: Fear and Future
videos.overview: After watching the scary movie, Thippu freaks out. Chinmayi and Shiva inform their respective parents about their final decision. Will their families agree to their alliance?

videos.title: Dissonant Voices
videos.overview: Subbu's mother watches Thippu making trip plans with Subramani and assigns him some work. Sushi gets angry with Udhay's grandmother's interference and berates him for being jobless.

videos.title: Serious Commitment
videos.overview: Serious about marriage, Chinmayi and Shiva try to convince their respective parents of the alliance. Thippu gets enraged as Yashika gets an acting opportunity alongside Sunil.

videos.title: Emotional Gambit
videos.overview: Chinmayi meets Shiva's parents while the latter visits her family to persuade them of their marriage. Thippu decides to test Shiva's love for Chinmayi. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Exposed Frames
videos.overview: Shiva and Chinmayi get Subbu and Subramani's consent. Keerthi is surprised as Mahi does not have his photo on his phone. Thippu flares up when Yashika and Sunil's selfie goes viral.

videos.title: Love's Test
videos.overview: Mahi's father visits the gym to see him and runs into Keerthi. Sharmila consents to Shiva and Chinmayi's marriage but on one condition.

videos.title: Moments of Destiny
videos.overview: Thanks to their parents, Chinmayi and Shiva decide what's best for their relationship. Thippu enjoys a joyful birthday until he has a fateful encounter at his shoot location.

videos.title: Clarifications and Confessions
videos.overview: Mahi promises to be an ideal partner to a tense Keerthi. Sharmila tries to blackmail Shiva emotionally. Thippu informs George that Yashika is family. Udhay's exam results are out.

videos.title: Endorsement
videos.overview: Sharmila invites Subbu for coffee and agrees to Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding without any condition. Yashika helps a pregnant Sushi at work. However, what is Sushi hiding from Udhay?

videos.title: Wedding Prelude
videos.overview: Chinmayi conveys her joy to Shiva, but Sheela tries to dissuade him from marrying her. Yashika warns Sushi against going on an outdoor shoot. The excited girls shop for the wedding.

videos.title: Celebration of Love
videos.overview: Everyone is happy at Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding. Subbu and Sharmila give emotional speeches. This time, Thippu joins in for a family photo.

videos.title: Pivotal Moments
videos.overview: The family misses Chinmayi. Sharmila tries to ruin Shiva and Chinmayi's wedding night. Raj seeks Keerthi's aid to convince Mahi to join the family business.

videos.title: Buzzing Headlines
videos.overview: Sushi is urged to rest and to refrain from going to work during her pregnancy. Thippu feels uneasy doing romantic scenes in front of Yashika. Thippu and Subramani’s news goes viral.

videos.title: Silent Confrontations
videos.overview: Chinmayi advises Subramani and Subbu to stay silent and not to respond to anyone. Thippu’s mother unexpectedly turns up and pressurises him to set up a meeting with Subramani.

videos.title: Fateful Encounters
videos.overview: Chinmayi informs Shiva that his mother's arm is not fractured. Yashoda visits the mess to meet Subramani and leaves her address. Subramani decides to tell Thippu the truth.

videos.title: Unexpected Arrival
videos.overview: Mahi's father, C. Mohan, agrees to help him start a sports academy. Chinmayi and Shiva pay her family a surprise visit. Is Subramani's truth in jeopardy with Yashoda's arrival?

videos.title: Solemn Confessions
videos.overview: Thippu informs Yashoda of the joyous days he shared with his father and the family. Keerthi gets a prominent post in Mahi's company. Thippu learns about his father's car driving skills.

videos.title: The Blooming Doubts
videos.overview: Subbu cautions Subramani to stay composed. Sharmila experiences an unexpected pain in her chest. Thippu begins to wonder if Subramani is indeed his father.

videos.title: Web of Confusion
videos.overview: Sharmila is rushed to the hospital after Shiva and Chinmayi ignore her calls. Keerthi informs Subbu that she loves Mahi. Thippu initiates an investigation to find who Subramani truly is.

videos.title: Masked Agendas
videos.overview: Subbu and Subramani go to the hospital to meet Sharmila. Mahi's father makes a cunning move in the guise of a gift for Keerthi. Yashoda denies knowing the person in the photo.

videos.title: Heartbreaking Losses
videos.overview: Sushi suddenly loses her balance and faints at work, leading to complications. After causing a drunken scene in front of Annam Mess, Thippu finally receives the DNA test result.

videos.title: Reckonings of Truth
videos.overview: A misunderstanding causes Udhay to hit Mahi. Subramani visits the old-age home and learns of Thippu's visit on his birthday. Subbu receives the DNA report and tries calling Thippu.

videos.title: Thippu's Fury
videos.overview: Hurt and angry, Thippu speaks harshly to reporters during a press meet. Subbu tells Thippu the whole truth, which drives Thippu over the edge.

videos.title: Celebrating Milestones
videos.overview: Keerthi makes arrangements for Subramani’s 60th birthday. Yashika stands firm when Sunil asks George to appoint her as his manager. Thippu is invited to Subramani’s birthday.

videos.title: Bewildered Hearts
videos.overview: Everyone enjoys Subramani's birthday party. But, Thippu's words hurt Subramani and Subbu. Unaware of the situation, the rest of the family gets perplexed by Thippu's unusual behaviour.

videos.title: Secrets Unravelled
videos.overview: Keerthi receives her first incentive for successfully achieving the sales target. Yashika tries to avoid Thippu. Meanwhile, Chinmayi finds the DNA report.

videos.title: The Investigation Unfolds
videos.overview: Yashika seeks Chinmayi's help to find a house to rent. While Chinmayi begins to investigate the truth of the DNA report, Yashoda decides to take legal action against Subramani.

videos.title: Web of Deceit
videos.overview: Yashika is shocked to learn from Thippu about their fathers. Chinmayi seeks a friend's help to gather information about Subramani. Thippu forgives Subramani and leaves the house.

videos.title: Path to Redemption
videos.overview: Thippu admits his feelings to Yashika. Mahi meets Keerthi's family to seek consent for marriage. Subbu opens up to her children as Chinmayi confronts her parents about Subramani's lies.

videos.title: Quest for Justice
videos.overview: Chinmayi decides to revive Kasinadhan's case. Mahi's father taunts Keerthi for falling for his son. Chinmayi tells Shiva the truth and resolves to stay with her father for a few days.

videos.title: Clues Uncovered
videos.overview: Yashika decides to resign from her job to distance herself from Thippu. Chinmayi begins to gather proof for the case in Kerala. Meanwhile, Yashoda lodges a complaint against Kasinadhan.

videos.title: Release Dilemma
videos.overview: Chinmayi orchestrates a way to evade her father's arrest. The news spreads, creating a sensation. Thippu tries to convince his mother to withdraw the case, but she has other plans.

videos.title: Words Unleashed
videos.overview: Mahi decides to reconcile with Keerthi once again. Chinmayi reveals her father's truth to her in-laws. Thippu apologises to Kasinathan.

videos.title: Threads Intertwined
videos.overview: Yashodha's lawyer attempts to gather information from Thippu. Chinmayi finds Rangan and tries to talk to him. Sushi prepares a gift for Udhay for his interview.

videos.title: The Last Supper?
videos.overview: Kasinathan gathers the whole family for a meal, believing it might be his last with them. The court hearing begins. Will Kasinathan be able to prove his innocence?

videos.title: Legal Battle
videos.overview: In the court, Rangan appears as an eyewitness. Udhay impresses the IAS panel with his confidence and insight. Mahi's father apologises to Keerthi for his past misconduct.

videos.title: Innocence Proven
videos.overview: Chinmayi presents irrefutable evidence, proving that Kasinathan is not a criminal but a man wrongly accused of murder. She questions Thippu and Yashodha and amazes all with her arguments.

videos.title: Heart’s Desire
videos.overview: Keerthi delights everyone with her anchoring skills. Yashika unveils her web series titled 'Uppu Puli Kaaram'. Thippu informs Kasinathan and Subbu about his intention to wed Yashika.

videos.title: Happy Ever After
videos.overview: The court issues a favourable verdict for Kasinathan. The wedding bells chime for Yashika and Thippu. There is happiness and laughter as everyone enjoys the special occasion together.

tamil-series.name: Parachute
tamil-series.description:
Shanmugam does not spare the rod and spoil his children. But despite his strict nature, they go on a joyride on his bike and get lost. What will he do now?

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar
📅 OTT Release: 2024-11-29
⭐ Rating: 9.0/10

videos.title: A Mother's Nightmare
videos.overview: Lakshmi goes to the police station to file a missing complaint about her children, Varun and Rudra. Where are they? How did they go missing?

videos.title: Love for Parachute
videos.overview: Varun plans a birthday surprise for his sister, Rudra, and it involves Parachute, their father's bike.

videos.title: Bikes and Bandits
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra desperately try to get their Parachute back, but an unforeseen incident occurs, which makes things worse.

videos.title: Kids in Danger
videos.overview: Kiruba and his team get the location of the stolen bike. He, along with Lakshmi, Shanmugam and Charles, race against time to save the children.

videos.title: Love Over Fear
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra get caught up in the middle of a riot. Will the kids get their Parachute back? Will Shanmugam and Lakshmi get to them before it's too late?

tamil-series.name: Goli Soda Rising
tamil-series.description:
In the bustling Koyambedu Market, four boys rise from obscurity to carve out their own identity. However, they realise that the pursuit of identity is endless.

📺 Streaming on: JioHotstar
📅 OTT Release: 2024-11-01

videos.title: The Identity
videos.overview: The Aachi Mess boys are all grown up and running their restaurant successfully in Koyambedu Market. Thillai is released from jail and comes across the four boys.

videos.title: The Unknown
videos.overview: Desperate for girlfriends, Kuttymani and Settu try to talk to a pretty girl using a unique method, which ends in a disaster. Meanwhile, Urundai is on the hunt for a mysterious bag.

videos.title: The Recognition
videos.overview: Urundai meets Ravi to talk about the mysterious bag. Inspired by a little tea seller, the boys launch a mobile restaurant in the new market. Ravi finds Thillai, shocking Maran.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Ravi entrusts Thillai with a new business, leading to a surprising reunion with his old love. Mayil gets released from jail and visits the boys.

videos.title: The Conflict
videos.overview: The boys await Mayil's return with the key to Aachi Mess. A murder rocks Thillai's water factory. Conflict erupts when Urundai hides his man from cops in the mobile restaurant.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Mayil finally knows the truth behind his arrest. Bhargavi advises Ravi on how to recover Benz's bag. Urundai's father finds the Aachi Mess receipt in Benz's belongings.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Twelve years ago, encounter specialist Samidurai was assigned to kill Ravi. Janaki learns that Maran knows Thillai. What happens when Aachi's boys refuse to give the bag to Benz?

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: The Aachi Mess boys fight to get back their van. The fight for the bag grows intense as Pilot also gets kidnapped.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: Naidu finds shocking evidence in the bag. Mayil meets Ravi with a hidden agenda. Thillai visits Janaki to reveal what happened to her father.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Fuming over Naidu's murder, the Aachi Mess boys and girls decide to kidnap Ravi. Meanwhile, Janaki gets crucial evidence about her father's death from an unlikely source.

tamil-series.name: Aindham Vedham
tamil-series.description:
Anu travels to Varanasi for her mother’s last rites, where a priest asks her to deliver an ancient relic to a temple in Tamil Nadu. While she plans to disobey his command, fate has other plans.

📺 Streaming on: Zee5
📅 OTT Release: 2024-10-25
⭐ Rating: 8.5/10

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: Anu meets a priest, who hands her an ancient box to be transferred to a temple in Iyerpuram. Although she is not keen on going, destiny brings her to Mithran, who offers to travel with her.

videos.title: The Mysterious Destination
videos.overview: Anu reaches the temple and decides to hand over the box, but things are not as simple as they seem to be. She finds herself stuck in the village with no way out.

videos.title: The Codex
videos.overview: A documentary filmmaker, Pathi tries to decipher the codex required to open the box. While Anu continues to struggle in the village, more people arrive with different agendas to get the box.

videos.title: Bheeja Mantra
videos.overview: The group of visitors manage to open the box but are shocked to find what it contains. An unexpected visitor and a shocking death make Anu nervous about the future. She also comes across a prophecy.

videos.title: Deciphering The Codex
videos.overview: Pathi is surprised by his son Vikas’s deciphering skills as he tries to solve the codex. Anu and her father discuss the village’s past. More people discover the 3D prototype of the box.

videos.title: Future Written In The Past
videos.overview: The village comes under Interpol's radar. Pathi realises that the inscriptions on the box can help in solving all the mysteries. Anu gets a vision in her sleep, which changes her perception.

videos.title: The Riddle
videos.overview: Anu finds the key to the temple. Pathi uses Vikas’s help in deciphering the codex. The gateway to the chamber is found but the Fifth Veda is missing!

videos.title: The Fifth Veda
videos.overview: The group is still coming to terms with the chamber’s secrets. While they try to find the missing Veda, Anu realises that the village prophecy means that she is the key to unveiling the Fifth Veda.

tamil-series.name: Snakes & Ladders
tamil-series.description:
Four reckless kids, while trying to cover up an accident, find themselves caught in dangerous situations - chased by cops, dim-witted thugs and their own bad choices.

📺 Streaming on: Prime Video
📅 OTT Release: 2024-10-18

videos.title: Square One
videos.overview: Gilly and his trio of companions are enjoying a contented existence in the peaceful town of Rettamugadu. However, their tranquillity is disrupted when Gilly has a fateful encounter, altering the course of their lives entirely.

videos.title: Four Feet Under
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by the situation, Gilly reaches out for help to navigate his turmoil, unaware of the intruder's ties to a criminal network. Gilly inadvertently discovers a locket pendant. Meanwhile, Chezhiyan and his senior officer are hot on the trail of a high-profile criminal.

videos.title: Friend or Foe?
videos.overview: Paari is being tormented by Rico and is coerced into disclosing the whereabouts of his partner. The children, feeling lost and uncertain, are jolted by the daunting realization of the immense task they must undertake.

videos.title: A Beautifull Mind
videos.overview: Sandy learns what Vinay is up to. Chezhiyan may have found important evidence in Raagi’s case. The kids find a clue that might help with their mission. Mahalingam is upset with Sandy. The number of adversaries against the kids is on the rise.

videos.title: Young Blood
videos.overview: Influenced by a powerful mafia figure, an unannounced inspection is conducted. In Rettamugadu, Leo forms a closer bond with Chezhiyan. A misstep by Sandy disrupts the kids' next plan of action and inadvertently creates a pathway for a new threat to emerge. Sandy takes it upon himself to nullify the risk.

videos.title: Back to Square One
videos.overview: Mahalingam attempts to break free from his confinement, while Raagi, along with the kids, visits her mother. The children reach a new unfamiliar place. Will this adventurous detour spiral into a series of unfortunate developments?

videos.title: A New Hope
videos.overview: The parents of the children are frantically searching for their missing kids. Chezhiyan might have made a major breakthrough in Raagi's case. The children must strategize a countermove to divert the trailing police.

videos.title: Larcenist
videos.overview: Despite being faced with tasks beyond their abilities, the kids must find a way to overcome them. Raagi confronts her deepest fear. While trying to mitigate a looming threat, Leo uses the opportunity to impress Airaa.

videos.title: Sought
videos.overview: The kids, the cops and the gangs find themselves facing their greatest challenges yet, with the stakes higher than ever before. When their narratives collide, chaos ensues, propelling a chain reaction of explosive encounters. Yet our heroes may not give up.
